en: The people that approaches its god in the cult of the art-religion is the ethical people, which knows its state and the actions of the state as the will and the accomplishment of its own self.

This spirit, therefore, stepping forth over against the self-conscious people, is not the being of light, which, being without self, does not contain the certainty of the individuals within itself, but is rather only their universal essence and the despotic power in which they disappear.

The cult of the religion of this simple, formless essence therefore gives back to its members only this in general, that they are the people of their god; it procures for them only their subsistence and simple substance in general, but not their actual self, which is rather cast aside.
For they worship their god as the empty depth, not as spirit.
The cult of the art-religion, on the other hand, lacks that abstract simplicity of the essence and therefore its depth.
The essence, however, that is immediately united with the self is in itself spirit and the knowing truth, though not yet the known truth, nor the truth that knows itself in its own depth.

Because the essence here has the self within it, its appearance is friendly to consciousness, and in the cult consciousness receives not only the universal justification of its subsistence but also its self-conscious determinate being; just as, conversely, the essence does not have a self-less actuality in a rejected people whose substance is merely recognized, but in the people whose self is recognized in its substance.
zh: 在艺术宗教的崇拜中接近它的神的那个民族，就是伦理的民族；这个民族知道它的国家以及国家的行动，就是它自己的意志和它自己的完成。
因此，这个与自我意识的民族相对立的精神，就不是那种光明本质——那种没有自我的光明本质，它本身不包含个体的确定性，而只是他们的普遍本质和那专横的力量，个体就在其中消失。
因此，对这个简单的、无形态的本质的宗教的崇拜，只一般地还给它的成员这样一点：他们是他们的神的民族；它只为他们赢得他们的持存以及一般的简单实体，却不赢得他们现实的自我，这个自我反而被摒弃了。
因为他们敬奉他们的神，是把它当作空洞的深渊，而不是当作精神。
而艺术宗教的崇拜，另一方面则没有本质的那种抽象的简单性，因此也没有它的深度。
但是，那个与自我直接统一的本质，自在就是精神和那知道着的真理，虽然还不是被知道的真理，也还不是那在自己的深度中知道自己的真理。
因此，本质在这里自身拥有自我，它的现象对意识就是友好的；在崇拜中，意识不只获得它的定在的普遍正当性，还获得它那在自身中意识到的定在；反过来也一样，本质不是在那个被摒弃的民族——它的实体只是被承认的民族——那里拥有无自我的现实性，而是在那个其自我在其实体中被承认的民族那里拥有现实性。

en: Out of the cult steps, therefore, the self-consciousness that is satisfied in its essence, and the god has entered into it as into his own place.

This place is for itself the night of substance, or its pure individuality, but no longer the tense night of the artist, which has not yet reconciled itself with its essence as it becomes objective; rather, it is the satisfied night, which possesses its pathos without needing anything, because it returns from intuition, from sublated objectivity.
– This pathos is for itself the essence of the rising, which, however, has now sunk into itself and has its sinking, self-consciousness, and thereby determinate being and actuality within itself.
– It has here run through the movement of its actualization.
Lowering itself from its pure essentiality to an objective natural force and the expressions of that force, it becomes a determinate being for the other, for the self, by which it is consumed.

The silent essence of self-less nature gains, in its fruit, the stage at which, preparing and digesting itself, it offers itself to the life of the self; it attains, in usefulness, in being able to be eaten and drunk, its highest perfection; for therein it is the possibility of a higher existence and touches spiritual determinate being; – partly to the quietly powerful substance, partly to spiritual fermentation, the earth-spirit has, in its metamorphosis, risen there to the feminine principle of nourishment, here to the masculine principle of the self-driving force of self-conscious determinate being.
zh: 因此，那在自己的本质中得到满足的自我意识从崇拜中走出来，神也进驻到它里面，就如同进驻到自己的处所一样。
这个处所自为地就是实体的夜，或者说它的纯粹个体性，但已不再是艺术家那种紧张的夜，那种紧张的夜还没有同它那正在变成对象性的本质和解；而是那满足了的夜，它无所欲求地拥有自己的激情，因为它从直观中、从那被扬弃了的对象性中返回。
——这个激情自为地就是那升起的本质，但它现在已经沉入自身，并且在自己本身拥有它的沉落、拥有自我意识，从而拥有定在和现实性。
——它在这里已经走完了它的实现的运动。
它把自己从它的纯粹本质性贬低为一种对象性的自然力及其表现，就成为一个为他物、为自我的定在，并被这个自我吞食。
那无自我的自然的静默本质，在它的果实中赢得了这样一个阶段：它把自己准备好并消化掉，从而把自己献给自我的生命；它在那能够被吃、被喝的有用性中达到它至高的完善；因为它在这种有用性中就是一种更高存在的可能性，并且触及了精神的定在；——大地精神在自己的变形中，一部分已经成长为静默有力的实体，在那里它就是营养的女性原则；一部分已经成长为精神的发酵，在这里它就是自我意识的定在所自行驱动的力的男性原则。

en: In this enjoyment, therefore, that rising being of light is betrayed as to what it is; this enjoyment is the mystery of it.
For the mystical is not the concealment of a secret or ignorance, but consists in the self knowing itself as one with the essence, and the essence thus being revealed.
Only the self is manifest to itself; or what is manifest is so only in the immediate certainty of the self.

In this certainty, however, the simple essence has been posited through the cult; as a useful thing it not only has the determinate being that is seen, felt, smelled, and tasted, but is also the object of desire and, through actual enjoyment, becomes one with the self and is thereby fully betrayed to this self and manifest to it.

– That which is said to be manifest to reason, to the heart, is in fact still secret, for the actual certainty of immediate determinate being is still lacking, both the objective and the enjoying certainty; but this certainty in religion is not only the thoughtless immediate certainty, but at the same time the purely knowing certainty of the self.
zh: 因此，在这个享受中，那升起的光明本质就被泄露了它究竟是什么；这个享受就是它的神秘。
因为神秘的东西并不是一个秘密的隐藏，也不是无知，而是在于：自我知道自己与本质是一体的，而这个本质也就由此被启示了。
只有自我对自身是显明的；或者说，凡是显明的东西，都只是在自我的直接确定性中才是显明的。
但是，通过崇拜，这个简单的本质已经被设置到这种直接的确定性之中；作为有用的物，它不只具有那种被看见、被摸到、被闻到、被尝到的定在，而且也是欲望的对象，并通过现实的享受与自我成为一体，并由此被彻底泄露给这个自我、对它显明。
——那个据说对理性、对心是显明的东西，事实上还是隐秘的，因为还缺着直接的定在的那种现实确定性——对象性的确定性和享受着的确定性都还缺着；而这种确定性在宗教中却不仅是一种无思想的直接确定性，同时还是自我那纯粹的、知道着的确定性。

en: What has thereby become manifest to self-conscious spirit within itself through the cult is the simple essence as the movement, partly to rise out of its nocturnal hiddenness into consciousness and to be its silently nourishing substance, partly to lose itself again in the subterranean night, in the self, and to linger above only with silent maternal longing.

– The pure impulse, however, is the many-named being of light of the rising, and its reeling life, which, having likewise let go of its abstract being, first occupies itself with the objective determinate being of the fruit, then, giving itself over to self-consciousness, attains in it its proper actuality, – and now roams about as a swarm of raving women, the unbridled rapture of nature in self-conscious shape.
zh: 因此，通过崇拜而在自我意识的精神自身中成为显明的，就是这个简单的本质，就是那种运动：一部分是从它夜间的隐藏中升起、进入意识，成为意识那静默滋养的实体；一部分则是同样又消逝在地下的黑夜中、消逝在自我里，而在上面只以静默的母性眷恋逗留。
——而这纯粹的冲动，就是那多名的升起的光明本质，就是它那眩晕的生活；这生活同样放弃了它的抽象存在，先把自己投入到果实中的对象性定在里，然后把自己交给自我意识，在自我意识中达到它本然的现实性，——如今则作为一群狂热奔动的妇女四处飘荡，那就是自然那未受约束的迷狂，处在自我意识的形态中。

en: But as yet, only the absolute spirit is betrayed to consciousness, the spirit that is this simple essence and not yet spirit as such, or only the immediate spirit, the spirit of nature.

Its self-conscious life is therefore only the mystery of bread and wine, of Ceres and Bacchus, not of the other, the truly higher gods, whose individuality, as an essential moment, contains self-consciousness as such within itself.
Thus spirit has not yet sacrificed itself to it as self-conscious spirit, and the mystery of bread and wine is not yet the mystery of flesh and blood.
zh: 但是，对意识来说，目前被泄露的还只是绝对精神——它还是这个简单的本质，还不是作为精神本身——，或者说还只是直接的精神、自然的精神。
因此，它的自我意识的生活还只是面包与酒、刻瑞斯与巴克科斯的神秘，还不是那些别的、真正更高的神的神秘；那些神的个体性作为本质环节，把自我意识本身包含在自身之中。
因此，精神还没有作为自我意识的精神向它献出自己，面包与酒的神秘还不是肉与血的神秘。

en: This unsteady rapture of the god must calm itself into an object, and the enthusiasm that did not come to consciousness must bring forth a work which stands over against it, as the statue stood over against the enthusiasm of the preceding artist, as an equally perfected work, but not as something lifeless within it, rather as a living self.

– Such a cult is the festival that man gives himself for his own honor, yet he does not yet put into it the meaning of the absolute essence; for the essence is only now manifest to him, not yet spirit; not as that which essentially assumes human shape.
But this cult lays the ground for this revelation and spreads out its moments individually.
Thus here [it is] the abstract moment of the living corporeality of the essence, as before the unity of both in unconscious frenzy.
Man therefore puts himself in the place of the statue as a shape trained and worked out for perfectly free movement, just as the statue is the shape of perfectly free repose.

If each individual at least knows how to present himself as a torch-bearer, then one of them stands out, who is the shaped movement, the smooth elaboration and the flowing force of all limbs, – an ensouled, living artwork, which mates strength with his beauty, and to whom the adornment with which the statue was honored falls as the prize of his force, along with the honor of being, among his people, in place of the stone god, the highest corporeal presentation of its essence.
zh: 神这种未定形的迷狂必须自己在对象中安定下来，而那没有达到意识的灵感则必须产生出一个作品；这个作品站在它对面，就像先前的艺术家的灵感之面对雕像那样，固然是一个同样完善的作品，却不是在它之中无生命的东西，而是一个活的自我。
——这样一种崇拜就是节日，人为了自己的荣誉而给自己安排下这个节日，但还不把绝对本质的意义放进它里面；因为对它来说，目前显明的还只是本质，还不是精神，还不是那种本质上采取人的形态的东西。
但这个崇拜为这种启示奠定基础，并把它的各个环节分别展开。
正如前面在无意识的狂热中是两者的统一，这里则是本质的活的身体性这个抽象的环节。
因此，人就把自己放到雕像的位置上，把自己表现为一个被锻炼、被打磨得能够完全自由运动的形态，而雕像就是那完全自由的静止。
如果每个个体至少都知道把自己表现为火炬手，那么他们当中就有一个人脱颖而出：他就是那有形态的运动、那平滑的打磨，以及流贯全身各肢体的力，——一个有灵的、活的艺术作品，美与强劲在它身上相结合；那用来尊荣雕像的饰物，作为他的力的奖赏而归于他；那份荣誉——在他的民族面前代替那石头的神、成为它的本质的最高的身体表现——也归他。

en: In the two presentations that just occurred, the unity of self-consciousness and of the spiritual essence is present; but they still lack their equilibrium.
In bacchic enthusiasm the self is outside itself, but in beautiful corporeality it is the spiritual essence.
That dimness of consciousness and its wild stammering must be taken up into the clear determinate being of the latter, and the spiritless clarity of the latter into the inwardness of the former.

The complete element in which inwardness is as external as externality is inward is language once again, but neither the one that in its content is wholly contingent and singular, that of the oracle, nor the sentient hymn that praises only the single god, nor the contentless stammering of bacchic frenzy.

Rather, it has won its clear and universal content — its clear content, for the artist has worked his way out of the first wholly substantial enthusiasm into the shape that is a determinate being of its own, penetrated in all its motions by the self-conscious soul and living along with it — its universal content, for in this festival, which is the honor of man, the one-sidedness of the statues disappears, which contain only one national spirit, one determinate character of divinity.

The beautiful fencer is, to be sure, the honor of his particular people, but he is a corporeal singularity in which the fullness of detail and the earnestness of the significance, and the inner character of the spirit that bears the particular life, concerns, needs, and customs of its people, has perished.
In this externalization to complete corporeality, spirit has laid aside the particular impressions and echoes of nature that it, as the actual spirit of the people, enclosed within itself.
Its people is therefore no longer conscious of its particularity in it, but rather of the laying aside of that particularity and of the universality of its human determinate being.
zh: 在刚才出现的这两种表现中，自我意识和精神本质的统一是存在着的；但它们还缺少自己的平衡。
在酒神的热情中，自身外在于自身；而在美的形体中，外在于自身的则是精神本质。
意识的那种昏暗和它的狂乱的嘟哝，必须被接纳进后者的明晰的定在之中，而后者的无精神的明晰，则必须被接纳进前者的内在性之中。
那完满的元素——内在性于其中同样是外在的，外在性于其中同样是内在的——又是语言；但它既不是那种在其内容上完全偶然而个别的、神谕的语言，也不是那样一支感受着的、只赞美单个之神的颂歌，也不是酒神狂乱中那无内容的嘟哝。
毋宁说，它已经赢得了自己明晰而普遍的内容——它那明晰的内容，因为艺术家已经从第一种彻头彻尾实体性的热情中脱身出来，把自己造就成了那个形态，这形态是它自己的定在，在它所有的激动中都被自我意识的灵魂所贯穿、并与这灵魂一同活着——它那普遍的内容，因为在这个节日里——这个节日就是人的荣誉——雕像的那种片面性消失了，那些雕像只包含着一个民族精神、只包含着神性的一个特定性格。
那位美的斗士固然是他的特殊民族的荣誉，但他是一个形体上的个别物；在那里面，意义的详尽与严肃、以及那个承载着它的民族的特殊生活、事务、需要和习俗的精神的内在性格，已经泯没了。
在这种向完满形体的外化中，精神已经脱去了自然的那些特殊印象和余响；它作为民族的现实精神，曾经把这些封闭在自身之中。
因此，它的民族由此意识到的，已经不再是它自己在其中的特殊性，而毋宁是这种特殊性的脱去，是它的人的定在的普遍性。

8.en: c. The Spiritual Work of Art

en: The national spirits, which become conscious of the shape of their essence in a particular animal, flow together into one; thus the particular beautiful national spirits unite into a pantheon whose element and dwelling is language.

The pure intuition of itself as universal humanity has, in the actuality of the national spirit, the form that it joins itself with the others, with whom it makes up one nation through nature, into a common undertaking, and forms for this work a whole people and thereby a whole heaven.

This universality, however, to which spirit comes in its determinate being, is only this first one, which has only just set out from the individuality of the ethical, has not yet overcome its immediacy, and has not formed a state out of these tribes.

The ethical life of the actual national spirit rests partly on the immediate trust of the individuals in the whole of their people, partly on the immediate share which all take, regardless of the difference of estates, in the decisions and actions of the government.
In the union, at first not into a lasting order, but only into a common action, that freedom of the participation of all and each is for the time being set aside.

This first communality is therefore more a gathering of individualities than the dominion of abstract thought, which would rob the individuals of their self-conscious share in the will and deed of the whole.
zh: 那些民族精神——它们在一个特殊的动物身上意识到自己本质的形态——汇合为一；那些特殊而美的民族精神就这样联合成一个万神殿，它的元素和居所就是语言。
对它自身作为普遍人性的纯粹直观，在民族精神的现实性上具有这样的形式：它同另一些民族精神联结起来——它同它们通过自然构成为一个民族——去从事一项共同的事业，并为了这项事业构成一个完整的民族，从而构成一个完整的天空。
然而，精神在自己的定在中达到的这种普遍性，还只是这第一种普遍性；它才刚从伦理的个体性出发，还没有克服自己的直接性，也还没有从这些部族中构成一个国家。
现实的民族精神的伦理，一部分基于个体对自己民族的整体的直接信任，一部分基于所有人对政府的决定和行动的那种直接参与——他们不顾等级之间的差别。
在这种联合中——它起初不是为了建立一个持久的秩序，而只是为了一个共同的行动——全体以及每一个人的那种参与的自由，暂时被搁置在一旁了。
因此，这第一种共同性，更多是个体性的一种集会，而不是抽象思想的统治；抽象思想会剥夺个体对整体的意志和行为的那份自我意识的参与。

en: The assembly of the national spirits constitutes a circle of shapes that now comprises the whole of nature as well as the whole ethical world.
They, too, stand under the supreme command of the One rather than under his supreme lordship.
For themselves, they are the universal substances of what the self-conscious essence is in itself and does.
This, however, constitutes the force and, at least at first, the center around which those universal essences busy themselves, and which seems only contingently to connect their doings.

But it is the return of the divine essence into self-consciousness that already contains the ground that this forms the center for those divine powers and hides the essential unity at first under the form of a friendly external relation of both.
zh: 民族精神的这种集会构成一个形态的圆圈，这个圆圈现在既包含整个自然，也包含整个伦理世界。
它们也同样站在那一位的最高指挥之下，而不是站在它的最高统治之下。
自为地，它们是普遍的实体，是那个自我意识的本质自在地是什么、做什么的普遍实体。
但这却构成着力，并且至少首先构成那个中心，那些普遍的本质都围绕着它忙活；这个中心起初看来只是偶然地把它们的事务联结起来。
但是，正是神性本质向自我意识的复归，已经包含着这样的根据：自我意识为那些神圣的力构成中心，并把本质的统一起初隐藏在双方的一种友好的外在关系的形式之下。

en: The same universality that belongs to this content necessarily also has the form of consciousness in which it steps forth.

It is no longer the actual doing of the cult, but a doing that, to be sure, is not yet raised into the concept, but only into representation, into the synthetic connection of self-conscious and of external determinate being.

The determinate being of this representation, language, is the first language, the epic as such, which contains the universal content, at least as the completeness of the world, though not as the universality of thought.
The singer is the individual and actual one, from whom, as the subject of this world, it is produced and sustained.
His pathos is not the numbing power of nature, but Mnemosyne, reflection and become inwardness, the recollection of the previously immediate essence.
He is the organ that disappears in its content; not his own self counts, but his Muse, his universal song.
But what is actually present is the syllogism in which the extreme of universality, the world of the gods, is connected through the middle of particularity with singularity, the singer.

The middle is the people in its heroes, who are single human beings like the singer, but only represented ones, and thereby at the same time universal, like the free extreme of universality, the gods.
zh: 隶属于这个内容的同一种普遍性，也必然具有意识的形式，内容就以这种形式出现。
它不再是崇拜中的现实行动，而是一种行动；这种行动固然还没有被提升到概念之中，而只是被提升到表象之中，提升到自我意识的定在和外在的定在的综合联结之中。
这种表象的定在，即语言，就是第一种语言，就是史诗本身；它包含着普遍的内容，至少是作为世界的完备性，虽然不是作为思想的普遍性。
歌者就是那个别的、现实的个体；他作为这个世界的主体，这个世界就是从他而来、被他产生并承载的。
他的激情不是那种令人昏迷的自然力量，而是 Mnemosyne——是沉思，是那生成了的内在性，是刚才那个直接本质的回忆。
他是在自己的内容中消失着的器官；算数的不是他自己的自身，而是他的缪斯，他的普遍歌唱。
但事实上存在着的，是这样一种推论：普遍性的极端，即神的世界，通过特殊性的中项，同个别性、同那位歌者联结在一起。
这个中项就是民族，是体现在它的英雄们之中的民族；这些英雄是单个的人，和歌者一样，但只是被表象出来的，并由此同时就是普遍的，正如那普遍性的自由的极端，即诸神。

en: In this epic, therefore, consciousness is in general presented with what comes about in itself in the cult, the relation of the divine to the human.
The content is an action of the essence that is conscious of itself.
The doing disturbs the repose of substance and excites the essence, whereby its simplicity is divided and opened up into the manifold world of natural and ethical forces.
The action is the violation of the quiet earth, the grave that, animated by the blood, calls forth the departed spirits, which, thirsting for life, obtain it in the doing of self-consciousness.

The business with which the universal endeavor is occupied has two sides to be accomplished: the self-side, by a totality of actual peoples and the individualities standing at their head, and the universal side, by their substantial powers.
But the relation of the two determined itself earlier such that it is the synthetic connection of the universal and the individual, or representation.
On this determinacy depends the judgment of this world.
– The relation of the two is thereby a mixture, which inconsistently distributes the unity of the doing and needlessly throws the action over from the one side to the other.

The universal powers have the shape of individuality and thereby the principle of action in them; their agency therefore appears as an equally free doing, proceeding entirely from them, as that of human beings.
One and the same have therefore been done just as much by the gods as by human beings.

The earnestness of those powers is a ridiculous superfluity, since they are in fact the force of the acting individuality; – and the exertion and labor of the latter is an equally useless effort, since the former rather steer everything,

– The mortals who are above the ground, who are nothing, are at the same time the powerful self, which subjugates the universal essences to itself, violates the gods and procures for them in general actuality and an interest in doing; just as, conversely, these powerless universalities, which nourish themselves on the gifts of human beings and only through them get something to do, are the natural essence and the stuff of all events, and likewise the ethical matter and the pathos of doing.

When their elemental natures are first brought, through the free self of individuality, into actuality and an activated relation, then they are just as much the universal, which withdraws from this connection, remains unrestricted in its determination and, through the invincible elasticity of its unity, extinguishes the pointedness of the active one and its figurations, keeps itself pure and dissolves everything individual in its fluidity.
zh: 因此，在这部史诗中，一般地向意识呈现出来的，是在崇拜中自在地成就出来的东西，即神性的东西对人的东西的关系。
内容是一个对自身有意识的本质的行动。
行动扰乱了实体的安宁，激动了本质，本质的单纯性由此被分开，向各种自然的力和伦理的力构成的纷繁世界敞开。
行动是对安静的大地的侵犯，是那座被血赋予灵魂的坟墓，它唤起那些离去的精灵，那些精灵渴望生命，便在自我意识的行动中获得它。
普遍的努力所从事的那件事，有两个要去完成的方面：自身性的一面，由一个现实的民族总体和站在它们前列的那些个体性来完成；普遍的一面，则由它们那些实体性的力量来完成。
但两者的关系此前是这样规定自己的：它就是普遍的东西与个别的东西的综合联结，或者说就是表象。
对这个世界的评判，取决于这种规定性。
——两者的关系因此是一种混杂，这种混杂前后不一地分配了行动的统一，并无谓地把行动从一面抛到另一面。
普遍的力量具有个体性的形态，并由此在自己身上具有行动的原则；所以它们的作用就显得同人的行动一样自由，也一样完全从它们自身出发。
因此，同一个东西同样是诸神和人做下的。
那些力量的严肃是一件可笑的多余之事，因为它们事实上就是那行动着的个体性的力；——而这一个体性所费的力气和劳作，也同样是一种无用的努力，因为前者毋宁说掌管着一切，
——那些地面之上的、什么都不是的凡人，同时又是一种强有力的自身，这种自身把那些普遍的本质置于自己支配之下，侵害诸神，并且一般地为他们取得现实性和一种行动的兴趣；正如反过来，这些无力的普遍物，它们靠人的馈赠养活自己，并且只有通过人才有事情可做，它们是自然的本质和一切事件的材料，同样也是伦理的质料和行动的激情。
如果它们那些元素性的自然通过个体性的自由自身才被带入现实性和一种起作用的关系，那么它们就同样是那种普遍的东西，这种东西脱离这种联结，在自己的规定上不受限制，并通过自己统一的不可战胜的弹性，抹掉行动者的点状性及其各种形态，保持自身纯洁，把一切个别的东西在自己的流动性中消解掉。

en: Just as they fall, together with the self-nature standing over against them, into this contradictory relation, so likewise their universality comes into conflict with their own determinacy and the relation of the latter to others.
They are the eternal beautiful individuals, which, resting in their own determinate being, are lifted beyond transience and alien power.
– But at the same time they are determinate elements, particular gods, which therefore relate themselves to others.
But the relation to others, which according to its opposition is a strife with them, is a comic self-forgetfulness of their eternal nature.

– The determinacy is rooted in the divine subsistence and has in its own limitation the independence of the whole individuality; through this their characters at the same time lose the sharpness of their peculiarity and mix in their manifold ambiguity.

– A purpose of activity, and its activity itself, since it is directed against an other and hence against an invincible divine force, is a chance and empty self-inflation, which likewise dissolves and transforms the apparent earnestness of the action into a danger-free, self-secure play without result and success.

But if, on the nature of their divinity, the negative or the determinacy of the latter appears only as the inconsistency of their activity and the contradiction of purpose and success, and that self-dependent security over against the determinate retains the upper hand, then it is precisely thereby that the pure force of the negative steps forth over against them, and indeed as their last power, over which they can do nothing.

They are the universal and the positive over against the individual self of the mortals, which cannot hold out against their power; but the universal self therefore floats above them and above this whole world of representation, to which the whole content belongs, as the concept-less emptiness of necessity, – a happening, against which they comport themselves without self and in mourning, for these determinate natures do not find themselves in this purity.
zh: 正如它们同与之对立的自身性自然一道陷入这种自相矛盾的关系，它们的普遍性也同样同自身的规定性、同这种规定性对其他东西的关系陷入争执。
它们是永恒的美的个体，这些个体在自己的定在中安居，摆脱了逝灭和异己的暴力。
——但它们同时又是一些规定的元素、一些特殊的神，因此它们也就同其他神发生关系。
但对其他神的关系，按照其对立性就是同其他神的争斗，这种关系是对它们永恒本性的一种可笑的自我遗忘。
——规定性在神性的持存中扎下了根，并且在自己的界限中拥有整个个体性的独立性；由此，它们的性格同时丧失了独特性的锋芒，并在多义性中互相混杂。
——活动的一个目的和活动本身，既然它是针对一个他者、因而是针对一种不可战胜的神力，就是一种偶然的空洞的自我膨胀，它同样会消散，把行动表面上的严肃变成一种无危险而自身确信的游戏，既无结果也无成效。
但是，如果在它们神性的本性上，否定性的东西或这种神性的规定性只显现为它们活动的前后不一和目的与成效的矛盾，而那种凌驾于规定性之上的自身镇定占了上风，那么恰恰因此，否定性的纯粹的力就出现在它们对面，而且就是它们最后的力量，对此它们无能为力。
它们是普遍的东西和肯定的东西，同凡人的那个别自身相对，而这种个别自身抵挡不住它们的力量；但普遍自身因此飘浮在它们之上、飘浮在这整个表象世界之上——全部内容都属于这整个世界——，作为必然性的无概念的虚无，——这是一种发生，它们无自身地、悲伤地对待它，因为这些规定的自然在这种纯粹性中找不到自己。

en: This necessity, however, is the unity of the concept, to which the contradictory substantiality of the individual moments is subject, in which the inconsistency and contingency of their doing orders itself and the play of their actions obtains its earnestness and worth in them themselves.

The content of the world of representation plays its movement, unbound, for itself in the middle, gathered around the individuality of a hero, who, however, in his force and beauty feels his life broken and, expecting an early death, mourns.
For the individuality that is firm and actual in itself is excluded from the extremity and divided into its moments, which have not yet found themselves and come together.

The one individual, the abstract unreal, is necessity, which has no share in the life of the middle, any more than the other, the actual individual, the singer, who keeps himself outside it and perishes in his representation.

Both extremes must approach the content; the one, necessity, has to fill itself with the content, the other, the language of the singer, must have a share in it, and the content previously left to itself must obtain in it the certainty and firm determination of the negative.
zh: 但这种必然性是概念的统一，那些单个环节的自相矛盾的实体性就服从于这种统一，在这种统一中，它们行动的前后不一和偶然性就自行归整，而它们行动的游戏也在它们自身中获得自己的严肃和价值。
表象世界的内容摆脱了束缚，在中间自为地展开自己的运动，聚集在一位英雄的个体性周围，而这位英雄在自己的力和美之中感到自己的生命破碎了，并且，预感早亡将至，满心哀伤。
因为在自身中坚定而现实的个体性被排斥在极端之外，并且分裂为自己的各个环节，这些环节还没有找到自己、还没有联合起来。
那个别的东西、抽象而不现实的东西，就是必然性，它同中间的生命同样没有份，正如另一个、那个现实的个体、那位歌者也没有份，而他把自己保持在这个生命之外，并且在自己的表象中消逝。
两个极端都必须接近内容；一个极端即必然性，必须用内容充实自己，另一个极端即歌者的语言，必须在内容中有份，而那个此前听任自身的内容，也必须在自身取得否定性的确定性和牢固的规定。

en: This higher language, tragedy, thus gathers the dispersion of the moments of the essential and acting world more closely together; the substance of the divine steps apart into its shapes according to the nature of the concept, and its movement is likewise in accordance with it.
In respect of form, language thereby ceases to be narrating, by stepping into the content, just as the content is a represented one.

The hero is himself the one who speaks, and the representation shows the listener, who is at the same time a spectator, self-conscious human beings, who know their right and their purpose, the power and the will of their determinacy, and know how to say them.

They are artists who, unlike the language that accompanies the common doing in actual life, do not unconsciously, naturally, and naively express the exterior of their resolve and beginning, but give utterance to the inner essence, demonstrate the right of their action, and deliberately assert and definitely express the pathos to which they belong — free of contingent circumstances and of the particularity of personalities — in its universal individuality.
The determinate being of these characters is, finally, actual human beings, who put on the persons of the heroes and present them in actual, not narrative, but their own speech.

As essential as it is for the statue to be made by human hands, just as essential is the mask to the actor — not as an external condition from which the contemplation of art would have to abstract; or, insofar as abstraction from it is indeed to be made in that contemplation, then just this is thereby said: that art does not yet contain the true proper self within itself.
zh: 这种更高的语言，即悲剧，因此就把那个本质的、行动着的世界各环节的分散更紧地聚拢到一起；神性东西的实体则依据概念的本性而分解为它的各种形态，它的运动也同样与概念相符合。
在形式方面，语言由于进入内容之中，就不再是叙说的了，正如内容是一种被表象的东西那样。
英雄本人就是说话的人，而表象把那同时也是观众的听众，领来面对一些有自我意识的人；这些人知道自己的权利和自己的目的，知道自己那规定性的力量和意志，并且知道怎样把它们讲出来。
他们是艺术家；他们不像那在现实生活中伴随普通行动的语言那样，无意识地、自然地、天真地说出自己决心和开端的外在东西，而是说出内在的本质，证明自己行动的权利，并且沉着地断言、明确地表达那属于他们的激情——这激情摆脱了偶然的情境和人格的特殊性，处在它那普遍的个体性之中。
这些性格的定在，最终就是现实的人；他们扮上英雄的人格，并用现实的、不是叙述的、而是自己本人的说话来表演他们。
正如雕像由人的双手制作出来是本质的，面具对于演员也同样本质——但这不是一种外在的条件，好像对艺术的观赏必须从中抽象出来似的；或者说，既然在对艺术的观赏中确实要从中抽象，那么这恰恰说明：艺术还不曾把真正的、本己的自我包含在自身之中。

en: The universal ground on which the movement of these shapes generated out of the concept proceeds is the consciousness of the first representational language and of its selfless, dispersed content.

It is the common people in general, whose wisdom comes to language in the chorus of the aged; it has its representative in the latter's impotence, because it itself constitutes only the positive and passive material of the individuality of the government that stands over against it.

Lacking the power of the negative, it is unable to hold together and restrain the richness and the colorful fullness of divine life, but lets it run apart and, in its worshipping hymns, praises each single moment as an independent god, now this one, now again another.

But where it feels the earnestness of the concept as it strides along over these shapes, shattering them, and gets to see how badly it fares with its praised gods, who venture onto this ground where the concept reigns, it is not itself the negative power that intervenes in action, but holds itself in the selfless thought of that power, in the consciousness of alien fate, and brings along the empty wish of reconciliation and the weak speech of appeasement.

In fear of the higher powers, which are the immediate arms of substance, of their struggle with one another, and of the simple self of necessity, which crushes them as well as the living ones bound to them, — in compassion with these, which it knows at the same time as the same as itself, there is for it only the inactive terror of this movement, the equally helpless lament, and, as the end, the empty repose of surrender to necessity, whose work is not grasped as the necessary action of the character nor as the doing of the absolute essence within itself.
zh: 这些从概念中产生出来的形态的运动于其上进行的普遍基地，就是那第一种进行表象的语言的意识，以及它的无自我的、涣散开来的内容的意识。
这就是一般的普通民众，它的智慧在老年人的合唱队中说出来；它在老年合唱队的无力中有自己的代表，因为它自己只是那与它相对立的政府的个体性的肯定的、被动的材料。
由于缺乏否定性的力量，它无法把神性生命的丰富和缤纷的丰满维系在一起并加以管束，而是让它四散跑开，并在自己敬拜的颂歌中，把每一个别环节都当作一个独立的神来赞美，一时是这个，一时又是另一个。
但是，当它感觉到概念的严肃——概念怎样踏过这些形态、把它们碾得粉碎——，并且眼看它那些受赞美的神下场有多糟——它们竟敢踏上这块概念统治着的基地——，它自己就不是那插手干预行动的否定力量，而是停留在对这股力量的无自我的思想之中，停留在对异己命运的意识之中，并带来那求和的空洞愿望和那安抚的软弱言辞。

在对那些更高的力量——它们是实体的直接的手臂——的恐惧中，在对它们相互斗争的恐惧中，在对必然性的那个单纯的自我——它把它们连同那些与它们相维系的生命者一并碾碎——的恐惧中，——在对这些力量的同情中——它同时知道这些力量就是它自己——，对它来说就只有这个运动的那无所作为的恐怖、同样束手无策的悲叹，以及作为终点的对必然性的听命的那空虚安宁；必然性的作品没有被把握为性格的必要行动，也没有被把握为绝对本质在自身本身的行动。

en: Upon this spectating consciousness as upon the indifferent ground of representing, spirit steps forth not in its dispersed manifoldness, but in the simple diremption of the concept.
Its substance therefore shows itself torn apart only into its two extreme powers.
These elemental universal essences are at the same time self-conscious individualities,
– heroes, who place their consciousness in one of these powers, have in it the determinacy of character, and constitute its activation and actuality.

– This universal individualization descends still, as was mentioned, to the immediate actuality of proper determinate being, and presents itself to a multitude of spectators, who in the chorus have their counter-image, or rather their own representation that expresses itself.
zh: 精神在这个旁观意识的身上、在这个表象的漠不关心的基地上，不是以它分散的杂多性出现，而是以概念的单纯的分裂出现。
因此，它的实体只显示为被撕开成它的两个极端的力量。
这些元素性的普遍本质同时就是自我意识的个体性，
——就是英雄；这些英雄把自己的意识放置在这些力量之一中，在它身上具有性格的规定性，并构成它的活动和现实性。
——这种普遍的个体化，如前所说，还下降到本己的定在的直接现实性，并把自己呈现给一大群观众；这些观众在合唱队中拥有自己的反面映像，或者说拥有自己的、把自身说出来的表象。

en: The content and the movement of the spirit that is here object to itself has already been considered as the nature and realization of the ethical substance.
In its religion it attains the consciousness of itself, or presents itself to its consciousness in its purer form and simpler formation.

If, therefore, the ethical substance divided itself through its concept, with respect to its content, into the two powers that were determined as divine and human, or as subterranean and upper right — the former the family, the latter the state-power — and of which the former was the feminine, the other the masculine character, then the previously multiform and, in its determinations, fluctuating circle of gods narrows itself down to these powers, which are brought closer through this determination of proper individuality.

For the earlier dispersion of the whole into the manifold and abstract powers, which appear as substantiated, is the dissolution of the subject, which comprehends them only as a moment in its self, and individuality is therefore only the superficial form of those essences.
Conversely, any further difference of the characters beyond the one named is to be reckoned to contingent and in itself external personality.
zh: 那在这里以自身为对象的精神的内容和运动，已经作为伦理实体的本性和实现被考察过了。
在它的宗教中，它获得了关于自身的意识，或者说，它在自己更纯粹的形式和更简单的构造中，向自己的意识呈现自己。
因此，如果伦理实体通过它的概念、就其内容而言把自己一分为二，分成那样两种力量——它们被规定为神的和人的力量，或者说被规定为地下的和上界的法权，前者是家庭，后者是国家权力——，并且这两种力量中前者是女性的性格、另一个是男性的性格，那么，先前那多形态的、在自己的规定中摇摆不定的诸神圈子，就收缩到这两种力量上；它们通过这种本己个体性的规定而被拉近了。
因为早先整体分散为那些杂多的、抽象的力——它们显示为被实体化了的——，就是那个主体的消解；主体只以概念把这些力把握为它自己自身中的一个环节，因此个体性只是那些本质的表面形式。
反过来，性格在刚才提到的区别之外再有区别，就要算到偶然的、自在地外在的人格账上。

en: At the same time the essence divides itself in respect of its form, or of the knowing.

The acting spirit steps forth as consciousness over against the object upon which it is active and which is thereby determined as the negative of the knower; the agent thereby finds itself in the opposition of knowing and non-knowing.

He takes his purpose from his character and knows it as the ethical essentiality; but through the determinacy of the character he knows only the one power of substance, and the other is hidden from him.

Present actuality is therefore one thing in itself and another for consciousness; the upper and the lower right acquire in this respect the meaning of the knowing power that reveals itself to consciousness and of the power that conceals itself and lies lurking in ambush.
The one is the light side, the god of the oracle, who, sprung from the all-illuminating sun according to his natural moment, knows and reveals everything,
– Phoebus and Zeus, who is his father.
But the commands of this truth-speaking god and his proclamations of what is are rather deceptive.
For this knowing is in its concept immediately the non-knowing, because consciousness in itself, in acting, is this opposition.
He who could himself unlock the mysterious Sphinx, like the childlike trusting one, is therefore sent to ruin through what the god reveals to them.

This priestess, out of whom the beautiful god speaks, is nothing other than the double-meaning sisters of fate, who through their promises drive to crime and, in the double-tonguedness of what they gave out as certainty, deceive the one who trusted the manifest meaning.

Hence the consciousness that is purer than the latter, which believes the witches, and more composed and thorough than the former, which trusts the priestess and the beautiful god, hesitates to take revenge on the basis of the revelation that the spirit of the father himself made about the crime that murdered him, and arranges still other proofs — for the reason that this revealing spirit could also be the devil.
zh: 同时，本质也就它的形式、或者说就那知识而分开了。
行动着的精神作为意识而与那个对象相对立；它作用于这个对象，这个对象也就因此被规定为认识者的否定物；行动者由此就处在知与不知的对立之中。
他从自己的性格中取出自己的目的，并知道这目的是伦理的实体性；但通过性格的规定性，他只认识到实体的一个力量，另一个力量对他则是隐藏着的。
因此，当前的现实性自在地是一回事，对意识来说又是另一回事；上界的和下界的法权在这种关系中获得这样的含义：一个是知道着的、对意识显现着自己的力量，另一个是隐藏着自己、在暗处窥伺的力量。
一个是光明的一面，是神谕之神；它就其自然的环节而言从普照一切的太阳中涌出，知道一切并启示一切，
——就是福波斯和宙斯，宙斯是他的父亲。
但是，这位说真话的神的命令、以及它对存在者是什么的宣示，反倒靠不住。
因为这种知在它的概念中直接就是不知，因为意识在自身中、在行动中就是这个对立。
那个能亲自解开谜一般的斯芬克斯的人，和那个孩子般信赖的人一样，都因神所启示给他们的东西而被送向毁灭。
这位美丽的神借以说话的女祭司，无非是那些语义双关的命运姐妹们；她们用自己的许诺把人推向犯罪，并在她们说成是确定无疑的东西的那样的模棱两可中，欺骗那个信赖显明含义的人。
因此，那个意识——它比后者、比那相信女巫的意识更纯粹，又比前者、比那信赖女祭司和那位美丽的神的意识更沉着、更彻底——迟迟不因父亲自己的精灵就那桩杀害他的罪行所作的启示而去复仇，并且还另行布置别的证据，——理由是：这个进行启示的精灵也可能是魔鬼。

en: This distrust is therefore well grounded, because the knowing consciousness places itself in the opposition of the certainty of itself and of the objective essence.

The right of the ethical, that actuality is nothing in itself over against the absolute law, experiences that its knowing is one-sided, that its law is only the law of its character, that it has grasped only the one power of substance.

The action itself is this inversion of what is known into its opposite, being; it is the overturning of the right of character and of knowledge into the right of the opposite with which the former is linked in the essence of substance — into the Erinnys of the other power and character, roused to hostility.
This lower right sits with Zeus on the throne and enjoys, with the manifest and the knowing god, equal esteem.
zh: 这种不信任因此是有根据的，因为那知道着的意识把自己置于它自身的确定性与那对象性的本质的对立之中。
伦理的法权——即那现实性在与绝对法则的对立中自在地什么都不是——经验到：它的知识是片面的，它的法则只是它的性格的法则，它只抓住了实体的一个力量。
行动本身就是这种反转：已知的东西被反转成它的反面，即存在；它就是性格的法权和知识的法权向对立面的法权的翻转，前者在实体的本质中同这对立面联结在一起，——也就是向另一个被敌意激起的力量和性格的厄里倪厄斯的翻转。
这下界的法权同宙斯一起坐在王座上，并同那位显明的神和那位知道的神享有同等的尊崇。

en: To these three essences the world of the gods of the chorus is restricted by the acting individuality.
The one is substance, as much the power of the hearth and the spirit of family piety as the universal power of the state and of the government.
Since this difference belongs to substance as such, it does not individualize itself, for representation, into two distinct shapes, but has in actuality the two persons of its characters.

On the other hand, the difference of knowing and not-knowing falls within each of the actual self-consciousnesses — and only in abstraction, in the element of universality, does it distribute itself to two individual shapes.

For the self of the hero has determinate being only as whole consciousness, and is therefore essentially the whole difference that belongs to the form; but its substance is determinate, and only one side of the difference of the content belongs to it.

Therefore the two sides of consciousness, which in actuality do not have a separate individuality proper to each, receive in representation each its own particular shape — the one that of the revealing god, the other that of the Erinnys keeping herself hidden.
Both partly enjoy equal honor; partly, the shape of substance, Zeus, is the necessity of the relation of the two to one another.

Substance is the relation that knowing is for itself, but has its truth in the simple; that the difference through which actual consciousness is has its ground in the inner essence that annuls it; that the self-clarifying assurance of certainty has its confirmation in forgetfulness.
zh: 行动着的个体性把合唱队的诸神世界限制到这三个本质上。
其一是实体，它既是灶火的力量和家庭孝敬的精神，也是国家和政府的普遍力量。
既然这个差别属于实体本身，它就不为表象而把自己个体化成两个不同的形态，而是在现实性中拥有它的性格的那两个人物。
反过来，知与不知的差别则落在每一个现实的自我意识里面，——只有在抽象中、在普遍性的元素里，它才把自己分配到两个个体的形态上。
因为英雄的自身只是作为整个的意识才有定在，因此它本质上就是那属于形式的整个差别；但它的实体是被规定了的，内容的差别中只有一面属于它。
因此，意识的那两面——它们在现实性中并没有各自特有的、分开的个体性——在表象中各自获得自己特殊的形态，——一面是那位显明的神的形态，另一面是那位把自己藏起来的厄里倪厄斯的形态。
两者一方面同等地受人尊崇，另一方面，实体的形态——宙斯——就是两者相互关联的必然性。
实体就是这种关系：知是自为的，但它的真理在那单纯的东西那里；现实意识由以而是的那个差别，在消灭它的内在本质中有它的根据；确定性那使自身明朗起来的确信，在遗忘中有它的证实。

en: Consciousness unlocked this opposition through acting; acting in accordance with the manifest knowledge, it experiences the deception of the latter, and, devoted to the inner in accordance with the one attribute of substance, it violated the other and thereby gave the latter the right against itself.

Following the knowing god, it rather laid hold of the non-manifest, and pays the penalty for having trusted knowledge, whose ambiguity, since it is its nature, must also have been present for it, and a warning against it must have been there.

The frenzy of the priestess, the inhuman figure of the witches, the voice of the tree, of the bird, the dream, and so forth, are not the ways in which truth appears, but warning signs of the deception, of the imprudence, of the singularity and contingency of knowledge.

Or, which comes to the same thing, the opposing power, which is violated by it, is present as expressly stated law and as valid right, whether it be the law of the family or of the state; consciousness, by contrast, followed its own knowledge and concealed the manifest from itself.

The truth, however, of the powers of content and of consciousness that come forth against one another is the result that both have equal right, and therefore, in the opposition that action brings forth, equal wrong.
The movement of doing demonstrates their unity in the mutual downfall of both powers and of the self-conscious characters.

The reconciliation of the opposition with itself is the Lethe of the underworld in death — or the Lethe of the upper world, as an acquittal not from guilt, for this consciousness cannot deny it, since it acted, but from the crime, and its expiatory calming.

Both are forgetting, the disappearance of actuality and of the doing of the powers of substance, of their individualities, and of the powers of abstract thought of the good and the evil; for none of them is the essence by itself; rather, the essence is the repose of the whole within itself, the unmoved unity of fate, the quiet determinate being, and thereby the inactivity and lifelessness of the family and of the government, and the equal honor, and thereby the indifferent unreality of Apollo and of the Erinnys, and the return of their inspiration and activity into the simple Zeus.
zh: 意识通过行动把这个对立解开了；照着那显明的知识去行动，它经验到了这种知识的欺骗；依着实体的一个属性而委身于内在，它触犯了另一个属性，并由此赋予这另一个属性以反对自己的法权。
追随那位知道的神，它毋宁抓住了那不显明的东西，并为曾经信任知识而赎罪；这种含混既然是知识的本性，对它来说也就必定在场，并且必定本来就有过一个针对它的警告。
女祭司的狂乱，女巫那不近人的模样，树的声音、鸟的声音、梦等等，都不是真理显现的方式，而是警告的信号：警告知识的欺骗、不审慎、个别性和偶然性。
或者，这等于说，那被它触犯的对立力量，是作为明说出来的法则和有效的法权而在场的，无论它是家庭的法则还是国家的法则；意识却相反地追随它自己的知识，把显明的东西对自己遮蔽起来。
但是，内容和意识那相互对峙的力量的真理，就是这样一个结果：两者有同等的法权，并因此——在行动所产生出来的对立中——有同等的过错。
行动的运动在两种力量和那些自我意识的性格的共同毁灭中，证明它们的统一。
对立同自身的和解就是死亡中下界的勒忒河，——或者是上界的勒忒河，即一种开释：不是从罪过中开释——因为意识既然行动过就不能否认罪过——而是从罪行中开释，以及它那起着赎罪作用的平息。
两者都是遗忘，都是现实性和实体诸力量、它们的个体性、以及善与恶的抽象思想诸力量的行动之消失；因为它们中没有一个是自为的本质，本质毋宁是整体在自身中的安宁，是命运那不动的统一，是安静的定在，并由此是家庭与政府的无所作为和无生命，是同等的尊荣，并由此是阿波罗和厄里倪厄斯那漠不相关的非现实性，以及它们的灵感和活动向单纯的宙斯的复归。

en: This fate completes the depopulation of heaven, of the thoughtless commingling of individuality and essence — a commingling through which the doing of the essence appears as something inconsequent, contingent, and unworthy of it; for, adhering to the essence only superficially, individuality is the unessential.

The expulsion of such unessential representations, which was demanded by the philosophers of antiquity, thus already begins in tragedy in general through this, that the division of substance is governed by the concept, that individuality is thereby the essential, and that the determinations are the absolute characters.

The self-consciousness that is represented in tragedy therefore knows and acknowledges only one supreme power, and this Zeus only as the power of the state or of the hearth and, in the opposition of knowing, only as the father of the knowledge of the particular that is becoming a shape — and as the Zeus of the oath and of the Erinnys, of the universal inward dwelling in concealment.

The moments that scatter farther from the concept into representation, which the chorus lets count one after another, are, on the other hand, not the pathos of the hero, but sink down, for him, into passion — into contingent, unessential moments, which the selfless chorus indeed praises, but which are not capable of constituting the character of the heroes, nor of being uttered and esteemed by them as their essence.
zh: 这个命运完成了天空的空无，完成了个体性和本质那无思想的混同，——这样一种混同，使本质的行动显得前后不一贯、偶然、配不上本质；因为个体性只是表面地依附于本质，所以它是非本质的。
把这类非本质的表象驱逐出去，这是古代的哲学家们要求过的，因此在悲剧中一般就已经开始了，途径在于：实体的划分由概念所支配，个体性由此就是本质的，而那些规定性就是绝对的性格。
因此，那在悲剧中被表象的自我意识只知道并且承认一个最高的力量，只承认这个宙斯是国家或灶火的力量，在知的对立中只承认它是那正在取得形态的特殊者的知的父亲，——并且承认它是誓言与厄里倪厄斯的宙斯，是那普遍的、寓于隐秘之中的内在。
那些从概念进一步散开到表象里去的环节——合唱队让它们一个接一个地算数——则反过来不是英雄的激情，而是对他降格为情欲，——降格为偶然的、非本质的环节；这些环节，那无自我的合唱队固然会赞美，却没有能力构成英雄们的性格，也没有能力被英雄们当作他们的本质说出来和尊重。

en: But also the persons of the divine essence itself, as well as the characters of its substance, merge into the simplicity of the unconscious.
This necessity has, in relation to self-consciousness, the determination of being the negative power of all shapes that step forth, of not recognizing itself in them, but rather of perishing in them.
The self appears only apportioned among the characters, not as the middle of the movement.

But self-consciousness, the simple certainty of itself, is in fact the negative power, the unity of Zeus, of the substantial essence, and of abstract necessity; it is the spiritual unity into which everything returns.

Because actual self-consciousness is still distinguished from substance and from fate, it is partly the chorus, or rather the watching crowd, which this movement of the divine life fills with fear as something alien, or in which, as something near, it produces only the stirring of a pity that does not act.

Partly, insofar as consciousness acts along and belongs to the characters, this union — because the true one, that of the self, of fate, and of substance, is not yet present — is an external one, a hypocrisy; the hero who steps forth before the spectator falls apart into his mask and into the actor, into the person and the actual self.
zh: 但是，神性本质本身的人物以及它的实体的诸性格，也汇合进无意识者的单纯性之中。
这个必然性对自我意识而言有着这样的规定性：它是一切出场的形态的否定的力量，它在这些形态中不认识自己，而是毋宁在其中消亡。
自身只是分摊给诸性格而出场，而不是作为运动的中项。
但是，自我意识，即它自身的单纯确定性，事实上就是那否定的力量，就是宙斯、实体性本质和抽象必然性的统一；它就是一切返归其中的那种精神的统一。
由于现实的自我意识还同实体和命运区别开来，它一部分就是合唱队，或者毋宁是观看的人群；这神性生活的运动作为一种异己的东西使他们充满恐惧，或者作为一种切近的东西在他们那里只引发出无所行动的同情的感动。
一部分，就意识也一同行动、并且属于那些性格而言，这种统一——因为真正的统一，即自身、命运和实体的统一，还不存在——是一种外在的统一，是一种演戏；在观众面前出场的英雄，就分裂成他的面具和演员，分裂成人格和现实的自身。

en: The self-consciousness of the heroes must step forth out of its mask and present itself as what it knows itself to be — the fate both of the gods of the chorus and of the absolute powers themselves — and it is no longer separated from the chorus, from universal consciousness.
zh: 英雄们的自我意识必须从自己的面具中走出来，把自己表现为它所知道自己的那样——既是歌队的诸神的命运、也是那些绝对力量本身的命运——并且它不再同歌队、同那普遍的意识相分离。

en: Comedy therefore has, to begin with, the aspect that actual self-consciousness presents itself as the fate of the gods.
These elemental essences are, as universal moments, no self and not actual.

They are, to be sure, endowed with the form of individuality, but this is only imagined into them and does not accrue to them in and for themselves; the actual self does not have such an abstract moment as its substance and content.
The subject is therefore raised above such a moment as above a single property, and, dressed in this mask, it utters the irony of the mask, which wants to be something in its own right.
The puffing-up of universal essentiality is betrayed to the self; it shows itself caught in an actuality and lets the mask fall precisely in wanting to be something rightful.

The self, appearing here in its significance as the actual, plays with the mask that it once puts on in order to be its persona; but just as soon it steps forth again out of this semblance into its own nakedness and ordinariness, which shows that it is no more distinct from the actual self, the actor, than from the spectator.
zh: 因此，喜剧首先具有这样一个方面：现实的自我意识把自己表现为诸神的命运。
这些元素性的本质，作为普遍的环节，不是自我，也不是现实的。
它们固然被赋予了个体性的形式，但这种形式只是被虚构给它们的，并不是它们自在自为地本身所具有的；现实的自我并没有把这样一个抽象的环节作为自己的实体和内容。
因此，主体被提升在这样一个环节之上，如同被提升在一种单一的特性之上；它一戴上这副面具，就说出了这副面具的滑稽反讽——这副面具却想要自为地就是一个东西。
普遍本质性的那种膨胀，已经向自我暴露；它显得被逮在一种现实性里，就在它想要成为一个正当的东西的时候，把面具丢掉了。
自我——它在这里是作为现实的东西、以这种意义出场的——玩弄着这副它为了扮成自己的人格而一度戴上的面具；但它同样很快又从这个假象里脱身出来，现出它自己的赤裸和平庸，这表明它同那个真正的自我、即演员，以及同观众，都没有什么区别。

en: This universal dissolution of shaped essentiality in general within its individuality becomes more earnest in its content, and thereby more wanton and more bitter, insofar as the content has its more earnest and more necessary significance.
The divine substance unites within itself the significance of natural and of ethical essentiality.

With respect to the natural, actual self-consciousness already shows itself, in the use of the latter for its adornment, its dwelling, etc., and in the feast of its offering, to be the fate to which the secret has been revealed — what is to be made of the self-essentiality of nature; in the mystery of bread and wine it makes this self-essentiality, together with the significance of the inner essence, its own, and in comedy it is conscious of the irony of this significance in general.

– Insofar as this significance contains ethical essentiality, it is partly the people in its two sides of the state, or the actual demos, and of familial individuality, but partly also self-conscious pure knowing, or the rational thinking of the universal.

– That demos, the universal mass, which knows itself as master and ruler and as the understanding and insight that are to be respected, coerces and beguiles itself through the particularity of its actuality, and exhibits the ludicrous contrast between its opinion of itself and its immediate determinate being, between its necessity and its contingency, its universality and its commonness.

When the principle of its individuality, separated from the universal, comes forth in the proper shape of actuality and openly usurps the commonwealth — whose secret bane it is — and sets it in order, then the contrast of the universal as a theory with that which it is to do in practice, the complete liberation of the ends of immediate individuality from the universal order, and the mockery of the former over the latter betray themselves all the more directly.
zh: 这种有形态的本质性一般而言在它的个体性中的普遍消解，在它的内容上变得更严肃，并由此变得更任性、更尖刻，因为内容具有它更严肃、更必然的意义。
神性的实体在它自身中统一着自然的本质性和伦理的本质性的意义。
就自然的方面而言，现实的自我意识——早在把自然用作自己的服饰、住所等等的时候，在它的祭献的宴饮之中——就已经把自己表现为这样的命运：自然的自在本性究竟有何底细，这个秘密已经向它泄露了；在面包与葡萄酒的奥秘中，它把这种自在本性连同内在本质的意义一并收为己有，而在喜剧中，它一般地意识到这种意义的滑稽反讽。
——既然这种意义包含着伦理的本质性，那么它一部分就是民族——在它作为国家、或者说真正的民众（Demos）与作为家庭个体性这两个方面中——另一部分则是自我意识的纯粹知识，或者说普遍者的理性思维。
——那个民众（Demos），那普遍的大众，它自认为是主人和统治者、也自认为是那应当受尊重的知性和识见，却通过自己现实性的特殊性既逼迫自己又蛊惑自己，并呈现出可笑的对照：它对自己的意见与它的直接的定在、它的必然性与偶然性、它的普遍性与卑贱性之间的对照。
当它那同普遍者分离开来的个体性的原则，以现实性的真正形态显露出来，公开地篡夺那共同体并着手安排它——它本是这共同体的暗伤——的时候，普遍者作为一种理论与它在实践中要做的事之间的对照、直接个体的目的从普遍秩序中的彻底解放、以及前者对后者的嘲笑，就更直接地败露出来了。

en: Rational thinking divests the divine essence of its contingent shape and, opposed to the conceptless wisdom of the chorus, which brings forth various moral maxims and lets a multitude of laws and determinate concepts of duty and right hold good, raises them up into the simple ideas of the beautiful and the good.

– The movement of this abstraction is the consciousness of the dialectic that these maxims and laws have in themselves, and thereby of the vanishing of the absolute validity in which they previously appeared.

As the contingent determination and superficial individuality that representation lent to the divine essences vanishes, they have, on their natural side, only the nakedness of their immediate determinate being left; they are clouds, a vanishing vapor, like those representations.
Having become, in their thought essentiality, the simple thoughts of the beautiful and the good, these tolerate being filled with any and every content.

The force of dialectical knowing abandons the determinate laws and maxims of action to pleasure and to the levity of youth — thereby seduced — and puts into the hands of the anxiety and care of age, restricted to the singularity of life, weapons for deception.

The pure thoughts of the beautiful and the good thus display the comic spectacle of becoming, through liberation from the opinion that contains both their determinacy as content and their absolute determinacy, the hold of consciousness, empty, and thereby of becoming the play of opinion and of the caprice of contingent individuality.
zh: 理性思维剥去神性本质的偶然形态，并且同歌队的无概念的智慧相对立——那种智慧搬出各种各样的道德格言，并让一大堆规律以及关于义务和法权的确定概念生效——而它则把它们提升到美与善的简单观念上。
——这种抽象的运动，就是对这些准则和规律自身所具有的那种辩证法的意识，并由此就是对它们先前出现时那种绝对有效性之消散的意识。
随着表象赋予神性本质的那种偶然规定性和浅薄个体性消失掉，它们就其自然的方面而言就只剩自己直接定在的赤裸了；它们是云，是一团正在消散的雾气，就像那些表象一样。
就它们被思想的本质性而言，它们已经变成了美与善的简单思想，因此它们容忍任何内容随随便便地填到自己里面。
辩证知识的力量，把关于行动的确定规律和准则交给快乐、交给那由此被引诱了的青年的轻浮去摆布，并把欺骗的武器交到老年的恐惧和忧虑手里——老年被局限在生活的个别性上。
因此，美与善的纯粹思想显示出这样一场喜剧性的演出：通过从那种意见中解放出来——那种意见既包含着它们的规定性作为内容、也包含着它们的绝对规定性，即意识的固持——它们变成空的，并由此变成意见的游戏、变成偶然个体性的任性游戏。

en: Here, then, the previously unconscious fate, which consists in empty rest and forgetfulness and is separated from self-consciousness, is united with the latter.

The individual self is the negative power through and in which the gods, as well as their moments — existent nature and the thoughts of their determinations — vanish; at the same time it is not the emptiness of the vanishing but preserves itself in this nothingness itself, is with itself, and is the sole actuality.
The religion of art has completed itself in it and has returned perfectly into itself.

By the fact that the individual consciousness, in the certainty of itself, is that which presents itself as this absolute power, this power has lost the form of something represented, separated from consciousness in general and alien to it, as the statue, the living beautiful corporeality, the content of the epic, and the powers and persons of the tragedy were; – nor is the unity the unconscious one of the cult and the mysteries, but the actual self of the actor coincides with his persona, just as the spectator is perfectly at home in what is represented to him and sees himself playing.

What this self-consciousness beholds is that in it whatever takes on the form of essentiality over against it is rather dissolved and surrendered in its thinking, determinate being, and doing; it is the return of everything universal into the certainty of itself, which thereby is this complete fear- and essencelessness of everything alien, and a well-being and a letting-itself-be-well of consciousness, such as none is found outside this comedy.
zh: 因此，在这里，那先前无意识的命运——它在于空的静止与遗忘之中，并同自我意识相分离——就同这自我意识联合起来了。
个别的自我是否定的力，诸神连同它们的环节——那现存着的自然和它们那些规定的思想——都通过这种力、并在这种力之中消失；同时，它并不是消失的那种空虚，而是在这种虚无本身中保持自己，是自己与自己同在的，并且是唯一的现实性。
艺术的宗教在它里面完成了自身，并完满地回到了自身。
个别的意识在对自身的确定性中就是那个把自己表现为这种绝对力量的东西，由此，这种力量就失去了那种被表象的东西的形式——那种同意识一般而言相分离、对意识陌生的形式——雕像、活的美形体、史诗的内容以及悲剧的诸力量和诸人格，曾经都是那样的形式；——这种统一也不是崇拜与秘仪的那种无意识的统一，而是演员的那个真正的自我同他的人格合为一体，正如观众在那被表象给他的东西里完全自在，并看到自己在其中演出。
这种自我意识所直观到的是：凡是在它面前采取本质性的形式的东西，反而都在它的思维、定在和行动中消解了、被抛撇了；这就是一切普遍者向它自身的确定性的复归，自我意识由此而是这种对一切陌生者的完全的无恐惧与无本质，是一种安适、一种听任自己安适的意识，除了这场喜剧而外，再也找不到别的这样的了。

en: Through the religion of art, spirit has passed from the form of substance into that of the subject, for it brings forth its shape and thus posits in that shape the doing, or the self-consciousness, which in the fearful substance only vanishes and in trust does not grasp itself.

This becoming-human of the divine essence starts from the statue, which has only the outer shape of the self about it, while the inner, its activity, falls outside it; in the cult, however, both sides have become one, and in the result of the religion of art this unity, in its completion, has at the same time passed over to the extreme of the self; in the spirit that, in the individuality of consciousness, is perfectly certain of itself, all essentiality has sunk away.

The proposition that gives utterance to this levity runs thus: the self is the absolute essence; the essence, which was substance and at which the self was the accidentality, has sunk down into the predicate, and spirit has lost its consciousness in this self-consciousness, over against which nothing steps forth in the form of essence.
zh: 通过艺术的宗教，精神从实体的形式进入了主体的形式；因为艺术的宗教把精神的形态产生出来，并因此在其中设定下行动、或者说自我意识——这种自我意识在可怖的实体中只会消失，在信赖中也把握不住自己。
神性本质的这种变成人，是从雕像出发的；雕像只具有自我的外部形态，而内在的东西、即它的活动，却落在雕像之外；但在崇拜中，两个方面已经合而为一，而在艺术的宗教的结果中，这种统一在其完成中也同时越到了自我的那一极端上；在那个于意识的个体性中对自己完全确信的精神里，一切本质性都沉没了。
说出这种轻佻的命题是这样的：自我就是绝对本质；那个本质——它曾是实体，自我在它那里曾是偶性——已经下沉为谓词，而精神在这个自我意识里——在这个没有任何东西以本质的形式同它相对立的自我意识里——丧失了自己的意识。

en: This proposition: the self is the absolute essence, belongs, as is self-evident, to the non-religious, the actual spirit; and it is to be recalled which shape of the latter is the one that expresses it.
It will at the same time contain the movement and the reversal of this proposition, which lowers the self to the predicate and raises the substance to the subject.

Namely in such a way that the reversed proposition does not, in itself or for us, make the substance into the subject, or — what is the same thing — restore the substance in such a manner that the consciousness of spirit is led back to its beginning, to natural religion, but in such a way that this reversal is brought about for and through self-consciousness itself.

In that this surrenders itself consciously, it is preserved in its externalization and remains the subject of the substance; but as thus externalized it at the same time has the consciousness of the latter; or, in that through its sacrifice it brings forth the substance as subject, this remains its own self.

Thereby it is achieved that, if in the two propositions, in the first the subject merely vanishes in substantiality, and in the second the substance is merely predicate, and both sides are thus present in each with the opposite inequality of value — that the union and interpenetration of both natures comes forth, in which both, with equal value, are as much essential as they are only moments; thereby spirit is as much consciousness of itself as of its objective substance, as it is simple self-consciousness remaining within itself.
zh: 这个命题：自我就是绝对本质，属于非宗教的、现实的精神，这本身就不言而喻；还要回想一下，这种精神的哪一种形态是表达这个命题的。
它将同时包含着这个命题的运动和颠倒，这个颠倒把自我压低为谓词，而把实体提升为主体。
也就是说，颠倒过来的命题并不是自在地、或并不是对我们而言把实体变成主体，或者说——这是一回事——并不是这样恢复实体：让精神的意识被带回到它的开端、即自然宗教；而是这样：这个颠倒是为着自我意识本身、并通过自我意识本身而完成的。
这个自我意识既然自觉地放弃自己，它就在自己的外化中受到保存，仍然是实体的主体；但正因为这样外化了，它同时也具有关于实体的意识；或者说，它既然通过自己的牺牲把实体作为主体产生出来，这个主体就仍然是它自己的自我。
由此就达到了：如果在两个命题中——在第一个命题里，主体在实体性中只是消失，在第二个里，实体只是谓词，因而两个方面各自都以相反的价值不平等出场——，即两种本性的联合和互相渗透产生出来，在其中两者以同等的价值既同样是本质的、同时也只是环节；因此，精神就既是关于它自身的意识，也是关于它那对象性的实体的意识，同样也是单纯的、留在自身之内的自我意识。

en: The religion of art belongs to the ethical spirit, which we earlier saw go under in the legal condition, that is, in the proposition: the self as such, the abstract person, is the absolute essence.
In ethical life the self is sunk in the spirit of its people; it is the fulfilled universality.
The simple individuality, however, raises itself out of this content, and its frivolity purifies it into the person, into the abstract universality of right.

In this abstract universality of right, the reality of the ethical spirit is lost; the contentless spirits of the individuals of the peoples are assembled into a pantheon — not into a pantheon of representation, whose impotent form lets every one have its way, but into the pantheon of abstract universality, of pure thought, which disembodies them and grants to the spiritless self, to the single person, being-in-and-for-itself.
zh: 艺术的宗教属于伦理的精神；我们早先看见这个精神在法权状态中沉没，也就是说，沉没在这样一个命题里：自我本身、抽象的人格，就是绝对本质。
在伦理的生活中，自我沉没在它的民族的精神之中；它就是得到了充实的普遍性。
而单纯的个体性则从这个内容中提升出来；它的轻浮把它清洗为人格，清洗为法权的抽象普遍性。
在这种法权的抽象普遍性中，伦理精神的实在性丧失了；那些民族个体的无内容的精神被聚集到一个万神殿里——不是聚集到表象的万神殿，表象那无力的形式对每一个都听之任之，而是聚集到抽象普遍性、纯粹思想的万神殿；纯粹思想剥去它们的身体，并把自在自为存在授予那无精神的自我、授予单个的人格。

en: But this self, through its emptiness, has left the content free; consciousness is only in itself the essence; its own determinate being — the legal recognizedness of the person — is the unfulfilled abstraction; it thus possesses only the thought of itself, or, as it is there and knows itself as object, it is the non-actual.

It is therefore only the Stoic independence of thought, and this, passing through the movement of the skeptical consciousness, finds its truth in that shape which was called the unhappy self-consciousness.
zh: 但这个自我由于自己的空虚而把内容放开了；意识只是在自身之内才是本质；它自己的定在、即人格在法权上获得的承认，是不曾充实的抽象；因此，它反倒只拥有关于自身的思想，或者说，如它存在着并把自己作为对象来知道，它就是不现实的。
因此，它只是思想的斯多葛式的独立性；这种独立性穿过怀疑论的意识的运动，就在那个曾被称为苦恼的自我意识的形态中找到了它的真理。

en: This knows what the situation is with the actual validity of the abstract person, and equally with the validity of the same in pure thought.
It knows such validity rather as the complete loss; it itself is this conscious loss of itself, and the externalization of its knowledge of itself.
– We see that this unhappy consciousness constitutes the counterpart and the completion of the consciousness perfectly happy in itself — the comic consciousness.
Into the latter, all divine being returns; or it is the complete externalization of the substance.
The former, on the other hand, is conversely the tragic fate of the certainty of itself that is supposed to be in and for itself.

It is the consciousness of the loss of all essentiality in this certainty of itself, and of the loss of precisely this knowledge of itself — of the substance as well as of the self; it is the pain that utters itself as the hard word that God has died.
zh: 这个苦恼意识知道，抽象人格那现实的效力是怎么一回事，也同样知道它在纯粹思想中的效力是怎么一回事。
它倒知道，这样一种效力就是完全的丧失；它本身就是这个有意识的自我丧失，就是它关于自身的知识的外化。
——我们看到，这个苦恼意识构成那个在自身之内完满幸福的意识、即喜剧的意识的反面和补充。
一切神性的本质都回归到后者之中，或者说，后者就是实体的完全外化。
反过来，前者则是那应当自在自为存在的自我确定性的悲剧命运。
它就是这种关于自身的确定性中一切本质性之丧失的意识，就是恰恰这种关于自身的知识——关于实体也关于自我——之丧失的意识；它就是那种把“上帝死了”这句硬话说出来的痛苦。

en: In the legal condition, therefore, the ethical world and its religion have sunk into the comic consciousness, and the unhappy consciousness is the knowledge of this whole loss.
Both the self-worth of its immediate personality and that of its mediated, its thought personality is lost to it.
Likewise, trust in the eternal laws of the gods, like the oracles that knew the particular, has fallen silent.

The statues are now corpses from which the animating soul has departed, just as the hymns are words whose faith has fled, the tables of the gods are without spiritual food and drink, and from its games and festivals the joyful unity of itself with the essence no longer comes back to consciousness.
The works of the Muse lack the power of the spirit from which, out of the crushing of gods and men, the certainty of itself came forth.

They are now what they are for us — beautiful fruits broken off from the tree: a friendly fate proffered them to us, as a girl presents those fruits; there is not the actual life of their determinate being, not the tree that bore them, not the earth and the elements that constituted their substance, nor the climate that made up their determinacy, or the change of the seasons that governed the process of their becoming.

– Thus fate gives us, along with the works of that art, not their world, not the spring and summer of the ethical life in which they bloomed and ripened, but only the enveloped recollection of this actuality.

– Our doing in the enjoyment of them is therefore not the worshipful one, through which our consciousness would acquire its perfect, self-filling truth, but it is the external doing, which wipes raindrops or specks of dust off these fruits and, in place of the inner elements of the surrounding, generating, and inspiriting actuality of the ethical, erects the elaborate scaffolding of the dead elements of their external existence — of language, of the historical, and so forth — not in order to live itself into them, but only to represent them within itself.

But just as the girl who proffers the picked fruits is more than the nature of those fruits spread out into their conditions and elements — the tree, air, light, and so forth — which immediately offered them, in that she gathers all this up in a higher manner into the ray of the self-conscious eye and the proffering gesture, so the spirit of fate that offers us those works of art is more than the ethical life and actuality of that people; for it is the recollection of the spirit still externalized in them — it is the spirit of the tragic fate that gathers all those individual gods and attributes of the substance into the one pantheon, into the spirit conscious of itself as spirit.
zh: 因此，在法权状态中，伦理世界及其宗教沉没在喜剧的意识之中，而苦恼意识就是这整个丧失的知识。
无论它的直接人格的自我价值，还是它的经过中介的、被思想的人格的自我价值，对它来说都丧失了。
同样，对神的永恒法则的信任，就像那些知道特殊事情的神谕一样，也沉寂了。
雕像如今是尸体，那赋予生命的灵魂已经离它而去；颂歌如今是话语，信仰已从其中逃散；神们的餐桌没有了精神的饮食；而从它的游戏和节日中，意识再也迎不回自己与本质的快乐统一。
缪斯的作品缺少精神的力；这种力从神与人的被碾碎中产生出关于自身的确定性。
它们现在就是它们对我们而言是的东西——从树上摘下来的美丽果实：一个友善的命运把它们递到我们手中，就像一个姑娘献上那些果实；这里没有它们定在的现实生命，没有承载过它们的树，没有构成它们实体的土地和元素，也没有构成它们规定性的气候，没有支配它们生成过程的季节变换。
——所以，命运随着那种艺术的作品给我们的，不是它们的世界，不是它们曾在其中开花和成熟的伦理生活的春天和夏天，而只是这种现实性的被包裹起来的回忆。
——因此，我们在享用它们时的行动，并不是那礼拜的行动——通过礼拜，我们的意识才会获得它那完满的、填满它的真理——，而是一种外在的行动：它给这些果实擦去雨珠或尘埃，并用它们外在存在的死元素——语言、历史事实等等——搭起一套庞大的架子，来取代那环绕着、产生着并赋予精神的伦理现实性的内在元素；这并不是为了把自己活进它们里面，而只是为了在自身之中把它们表象出来。

但是，正如献上摘来的果实的那个姑娘，比起果实的自然——它直接提供了这些果实，并展开为它的条件和元素：树、空气、光等等——要更多一些，因为她以更高的方式把这全部收拢到那自我意识的目光和献赠之姿的光辉里，——同样，那把这些艺术作品献给我们的命运的精神，也比那个民族的伦理生活和现实性更多；因为它就是那在这些作品中还外化着的精神的回忆，——它就是那悲剧命运的精神；这命运把所有那些个体性的神和实体的属性都聚集到同一个万神殿里，聚集到那个作为精神而自觉的精神里。

en: All the conditions of its emergence are present, and this totality of its conditions constitutes the becoming, the concept, or the in-itself emerging of the same.

– The circle of the productions of art encompasses the forms of the externalizations of the absolute substance; it is in the form of individuality, as a thing, as the existent object of sensuous consciousness, – as pure language, or the becoming of the shape whose determinate being does not step out of the self and is a purely vanishing object, – as immediate unity with the universal self-consciousness in its enthusiasm, and as mediated unity in the doing of the cult, – as beautiful self-like corporeality, and finally as the determinate being raised up into representation and the expansion of the same into a world that finally gathers itself into universality, which is likewise pure certainty of itself.

– These forms, and on the other side the world of person and of right, the devastating wildness of the set-free elements of content, likewise the thought person of Stoicism and the groundless unrest of the sceptical consciousness, make up the periphery of the shapes which stand around, waiting and pressing, the birthplace of the spirit that is becoming self-consciousness; the all-penetrating pain and longing of the unhappy consciousness is their center and the common birth-pang of its emergence — the simplicity of the pure concept, which contains those shapes as its moments.
zh: 它出场的全部条件都已齐备，而这些条件的总体性构成了它的生成、它的概念，或者说这同一个东西的自在的出场。

——艺术创造物的这个圈子包含着绝对实体的诸外化的形式；绝对实体在个体性的形式中，作为一个物，作为感性意识的现存对象，——作为纯粹的语言，或者说作为那样一种形态的生成：这种形态的定在不从自我中走出，并且纯粹是一个正在消失的对象，——作为同普遍的自我意识在它的热情中的直接统一，并作为在崇拜的行动中的被中介的统一，——作为美的自体形体，最后，作为被提升进表象的定在以及这同一个东西向一个世界的扩展，这个世界最终把自己收拢进普遍性之中，而这个普遍性同样就是它自身的纯粹确定性。
——这些形态，以及另一方面的那个人格与法权的世界、那内容中被解放出来的元素的破坏性野性、同样还有斯多葛主义那个被思维的人格和怀疑论意识那无所依持的不安，构成了那些形态的外围；这些形态期待着、逼迫着，围立在那个正在成为自我意识的精神的出生地的四周；苦恼意识那贯穿一切的痛苦和渴望是它们的中心，是它的出场的共同的产痛——是纯概念的单纯性，纯概念把那些形态作为自己的环节包含在自身中。

en: It has the two sides in it which were presented above as the two inverted propositions; the one is this, that the substance externalizes itself out of itself and becomes self-consciousness, the other conversely, that self-consciousness externalizes itself out of it and makes itself into thinghood or into the universal self.
In this way both sides have come to meet each other, and through this their true union has come about.

The externalization of the substance, its becoming self-consciousness, expresses the transition into the opposite, the unconscious transition of necessity, or else expresses this, that it is in itself self-consciousness; conversely, the externalization of self-consciousness expresses this, that it is in itself the universal essence, or — because the self is pure being-for-self, which remains with itself in its opposite — this, that for it it is the case that substance is self-consciousness and precisely thereby is spirit.

Of this spirit, therefore — which has left the form of substance and enters into determinate being in the shape of self-consciousness — it can be said, if one wants to make use of the relations taken from natural generation, that it has an actual mother but an in-itself father; for actuality, or self-consciousness, and the in-itself as substance are its two moments, through whose mutual externalization, each becoming the other, it enters into determinate being as this their unity.
zh: 它在自身中有那两个方面，它们在上面曾经作为两个颠倒的命题被表象出来；一个是这样：实体把它自己从自身中外化出来，并变成自我意识；另一个则反过来：自我意识把它自己从实体那里外化出去，并使自己变成物性或普遍的自我。
两个方面就这样走到了一起，并由此产生了它们真正的联合。
实体的外化、实体变成自我意识，表达着向对立面的过渡，表达着必然性的无意识的过渡，或者说表达着这一点：实体自在地就是自我意识；反过来，自我意识的外化则表达着这一点：它自在地就是普遍的本质，或者——因为自我是纯粹的自为存在，是那个在自己的对立面中仍然与自己同在的东西——表达着这一点：对它而言，实体是自我意识并恰恰因此而是精神。
因此，关于这个精神——它离开了实体的形式，以自我意识的形态进入定在——可以这样说，如果人们愿意利用那些从自然生育中取来的关系的话：它有一个现实的母亲，但却只有一个自在的父亲；因为现实性、或者说自我意识，与作为实体的自在，是它的两个环节，通过它们相互的外化——每一个都变成另一个——它作为它们这个统一体进入定在。

en: Insofar as self-consciousness one-sidedly grasps only its own externalization — even though its object is thus just as much being as self and it knows all determinate being as spiritual essence — the true spirit has nonetheless not thereby yet come to be for it, namely insofar as being in general, or substance, did not likewise in its turn externalize itself out of itself and become self-consciousness.
For then all determinate being is spiritual essence only from the standpoint of consciousness, not in itself itself.

Spirit is in this way merely imagined into determinate being; this imagining is fanaticism, which puts into nature as well as history, just as into the world, and into the mythical representations of the preceding religions another inner sense than the one they immediately present to consciousness in their appearance and than the one consciousness knew in them — in respect of the religions — as the self-consciousness whose religions they were.

But this meaning is a borrowed one and a garment that does not cover the nakedness of the appearance and wins itself no faith and veneration, but remains the dark night and the private rapture of consciousness.
zh: 既然自我意识只是片面地把握它自己的外化——纵然它的对象因此同样地既是存在又是自我，并且它把一切定在都知道为精神的本质——真正的精神就还没有由此为它而产生，这就是说：一般的存在、或者说实体，并没有同样反过来在自身中把它自己外化、变成自我意识。
因为这样一来，一切定在就只是从意识的立场看才是精神的本质，并不是在它自身中就是精神的本质。
精神以这种方式只是被臆想进定在；这种臆想就是狂热：它给自然、也给历史，给世界，也给先前那些宗教的神话表象，安插一种别样的内在意义，与它们在自己的现象中直接呈现给意识的东西不同，——就那些宗教而言——也不同于意识在其中、作为那个以这些宗教为自己的宗教的自我意识、所认识到的东西。
但这种意义是一种借来的意义，是一件衣裳，它遮不住现象的赤裸，也为自己挣不到信仰和崇敬，而始终只是意识的沉沉黑夜和它自己的迷狂。

en: That this meaning of the objective is not to be mere imagination — for this it must be in itself, that is, for one thing, it must spring forth for consciousness out of the concept and come forth in its necessity.
Thus, through the cognition of immediate consciousness, or of the consciousness of the existent object, through its necessary movement, the self-knowing spirit has sprung forth for us.

This concept, which, as immediate, also had the shape of immediacy for its consciousness, has secondly given itself the shape of self-consciousness in itself — that is, in accordance with this very necessity of the concept — in that the being, or the immediacy, which is the contentless object of sensuous consciousness, externalizes itself out of it and becomes an 'I' for consciousness.

– The immediate in-itself, or the existent necessity itself, is, however, distinct from the thinking in-itself, or from the cognition of necessity — a difference which at the same time, however, does not lie outside the concept, for the simple unity of the concept is the immediate being itself; it is just as much that which externalizes itself, or the becoming of the intuited necessity, as it is with itself in that necessity and knows and comprehends it.

– The immediate in-itself of the spirit that gives itself the shape of self-consciousness means nothing other than that the actual world-spirit has arrived at this knowledge of itself; only then does this knowledge also enter into its consciousness and enter as truth.
How that has come about has already been shown above.
zh: 客观东西的这个意义要不只是臆想，它就必须在自身中存在，也就是说，它必须一方面为意识从概念中迸发出来，并在它的必然性中产生出来。
这样一来，通过对直接意识、或者说对那现存对象的意识所作的认识，通过它的必然运动，那自己知道自己的精神就为我们产生出来了。
这个概念，它作为直接的东西也曾把直接性的形态作为它的意识的形态，其次就按照概念的这同一个必然性，在自身中把自我意识的形态给予了自己；这就是说：那个存在、那个直接性——它是感性意识的那无内容的对象——把它自己从那里外化出去，并为意识变成一个“我”。
——但是，直接的自身、或者说那现存着的必然性本身，是同思维的自身、同对必然性的认识有区别的，——这种区别同时却又不在概念之外，因为概念的单纯统一就是直接的存在本身；概念同样是那自己外化自己的东西、或者说那被直观的必然性的生成，正如它在必然性中与自己同在、知道并把握必然性。
——那个赋予自己以自我意识的形态的精神的直接的自身，不外是说：现实的世界精神已经达到了关于自己的这个知识；只有到那时，这个知识才也进入它的意识，并作为真理进入其中。
这是如何发生的，在上面已经得出来了。

en: The fact that the absolute spirit has given itself the shape of self-consciousness in itself, and thereby also for its consciousness, now appears in this way: it is the faith of the world that the spirit is present as a self-consciousness, that is, as an actual human being; that he is present for immediate certainty; that the believing consciousness sees and feels and hears this divinity.
Thus it is not imagination, but it is really so.

Consciousness then does not proceed from within, from thought, and combine within itself the thought of God with determinate being, but proceeds from the immediate present determinate being and recognizes God in it.

– The moment of immediate being is present in the content of the concept in such a way that the religious spirit, in the return of all essentiality into consciousness, has become the simple positive self, just as the actual spirit as such is, in the unhappy consciousness, precisely this simple self-conscious negativity.

The self of the existent spirit thereby has the form of complete immediacy; it is posited neither as something thought, nor as represented, nor as produced — as is the case with the immediate self partly in natural religion and partly in the religion of art.
Rather, this God is immediately intuited as a self, as an actual individual human being, in a sensuous manner; only thus is he self-consciousness.
zh: 绝对精神在自身中、并从而也为它的意识赋予自己以自我意识的形态，这件事现在显现为世界的信仰：精神作为自我意识、也就是作为一个现实的人而在场，他为直接的确定性而在场，信仰的意识看见、感到、听到这种神性。
因此这不是臆想，而是真的就是如此。
因此，意识不是从它的内在、从思想出发，在自身中把上帝的思想同定在结合起来，而是从直接的、当下的定在出发，并在其中认识到上帝。
——直接存在的环节在概念的内容中是这样现成存在着的：宗教精神在一切本质性返回到意识中的时候，已经成为单纯肯定的自我，正如现实的精神本身在苦恼意识中恰恰就是这种单纯的、自己知道自己的否定性。
定在着的精神的自我由此具有完全的直接性的形态；它既不是作为被思维的东西、也不是作为被表象的东西、也不是作为被产生出来的东西而被设定下来，而直接的自我的情形却一部分在自然宗教中、一部分在艺术宗教中是这样的。
而是这个上帝直接地作为自我、作为一个现实的个别的人，感性地被直观；只有这样，他才是自我意识。

en: This becoming-human of the divine essence, or the fact that it essentially and immediately has the shape of self-consciousness, is the simple content of the absolute religion.
In it the essence is known as spirit, or it is the essence's own consciousness of itself as spirit.
For spirit is the knowledge of itself in its externalization; the essence which is the movement of maintaining equality with itself in its otherness.

But this is substance, insofar as it is likewise reflected into itself in its accidentality, not, by contrast, as if it were indifferent to the accidentality as to an unessential and hence as something that finds itself in a foreign element, but is therein within itself — that is, insofar as it is subject or self.
– Therefore in this religion the divine essence is revealed.
Its revealedness obviously consists in the fact that what it is is known.
But it is known precisely in being known as spirit, as the essence that essentially is self-consciousness.
– Consciousness has something secret in its object when the object is an other or a foreign thing for it and when it does not know the object as itself.

This being-secret ceases in that the absolute essence is the object of consciousness as spirit; for thus it is, as self, in its relation to consciousness; i.e. consciousness immediately knows itself in it, or the essence is revealed to itself therein.

It itself is revealed to itself only in its own certainty; the object of that consciousness is the self, and the self is nothing foreign, but the inseparable unity with itself, the immediately universal.

It is the pure concept, pure thinking, or being-for-self, which is immediate being and thereby being for another, and, as this being for another, has immediately returned into itself and is with itself; it is thus the truly and solely revealed.

The good, the just, the holy, the creator of heaven and earth, etc., are predicates of a subject — universal moments which have their support at this point and are only in the return of consciousness into thinking.
– Inasmuch as they are known, their ground and essence, the subject itself, is not yet revealed, and likewise the determinations of the universal are not this universal itself.

But the subject itself, and thereby also this pure universal, is revealed as self; for this is precisely this inwardly reflected inwardness, which is immediately present and is the own certainty of that self for which it is present.
This — to be, in accordance with its concept, the revealed — is therefore the true shape of spirit, and this its shape, the concept, is likewise alone its essence and substance.

It is known as self-consciousness and is immediately revealed to self-consciousness, for it is self-consciousness itself; the divine nature is the same as the human nature, and it is this unity that is intuited.
zh: 神性本质的这种变成人，或者说神性本质本质上直接地具有自我意识的形态，这就是绝对宗教的单纯内容。
在这种宗教中，本质被知道为精神，或者说，它就是本质关于自己、关于自己是精神的意识。
因为精神就是它在自身的外化中对自身的知识；精神是这样的本质：它是运动，就是在自己的他在中保持自己同自己的等同。
但这也就是实体：实体在它的偶性中同样反思到自身，它并不是把偶性当作某种非本质的东西、因而当作某种在陌生东西中存在着的东西而漠然处之，而是在其中就在自身——就此而言，实体就是主体或自我。
——因此，在这种宗教中，神性本质是天启的。
它的这种天启显然就在于：它之所是被知道了。
但它恰恰是在它作为精神而被知道时被知道的，即被知道为那样一个本质：它在本质上就是自我意识。
——当对象对于意识是一个他者或一个陌生的东西、当意识不知道对象就是它自身的时候，意识在它的对象中就有某种隐秘的东西。
这种隐秘状态停止了，因为绝对本质作为精神是意识的对象；因为这样一来，绝对本质就在它对意识的关系中作为自我而存在；这就是说，意识直接地在其中知道它自己，或者说，绝对本质在它之中对它自己就是天启的。
绝对本质自身只是在对自己的确定性中、对它自己是天启的；那个意识的对象就是自我，而自我不是什么陌生的东西，而是同自身的不可分割的统一，是直接的普遍者。
它就是纯概念、纯思维或自为存在，它直接地就是存在并因而是为他的存在，并且作为这种为他的存在直接地返回到自身、自己与自己同在；因此它就是那真正的、唯一天启的东西。
善的、正义的、神圣的、天地的创造者等等，都是一个主体的谓词，——是普遍的环节，它们在这个点上获得自己的支撑，并且只有在意识返回到思维之中时才是存在的。
——在它们被知道的时候，它们的根据和本质、即主体本身，还没有是天启的，同样，普遍者的那些规定也不是这个普遍者本身。
但主体本身、并从而也连同这个纯粹的普遍者，是作为自我而天启的；因为这恰恰就是这个在自身中反思着的内在，它直接地在场，并且是那个自我的自己的确定性——它就是为这个自我而在场的。
这个——按其概念就是要成为天启的东西——因此就是精神的真正形态；而精神的这个形态、即概念，同样仅仅是它的本质和实体。
精神被知道为自我意识，并对自我意识直接地就是天启的，因为精神就是自我意识本身；神性的本质与人的本质是同一个东西，而被直观到的就是这个统一。

en: Here, then, is in fact the consciousness — or the mode in which the essence is for itself — as its shape, equal to its self-consciousness; this shape is itself a self-consciousness; it is thereby at the same time an existent object, and this being has just as immediately the significance of pure thinking, of the absolute essence.
– The absolute essence, which is present as an actual self-consciousness, seems to have descended from its eternal simplicity, but in fact it has thereby only first attained its highest essence.

For the concept of the essence, only when it has attained its simple purity, is the absolute abstraction, which is pure thinking and thereby the pure singularity of the self and, by virtue of its simplicity, the immediate, or being.
– What is called sensuous consciousness is precisely this pure abstraction; it is this thinking, for which being is the immediate.
The lowest is thus at the same time the highest; what has emerged quite to the surface, the manifest, is precisely therein the deepest.

That the highest essence is seen, heard, and so forth as an existent self-consciousness — this is in fact the consummation of its concept; and through this consummation the essence is as immediately present as it is essence.
zh: 因此，在这里，事实上，意识——或者说本质为它自身而是的那种方式——就是它的形态，与它的自我意识相等同；这种形态本身就是一个自我意识；它由此同时是一个存在着的对象，而这种存在同样直接地具有纯粹思维、具有绝对本质的意义。
——那个作为一个现实的自我意识而在场的绝对本质，看起来仿佛是从它那永恒的单纯性中下降过来的，但事实上它由此才第一次达到它的最高本质。
因为本质的概念，只有在它取得了自己那种单纯的纯洁性时，才是那种绝对的抽象，即纯粹思维，并由此而是自我的纯粹单一性，且正由于其单纯性而是直接的东西或存在。
——那被称为感性的意识的东西，恰恰就是这种纯粹的抽象；它就是这种思维，对于这种思维来说，存在就是直接的东西。
因此，最低的东西同时就是最高的东西；那完全涌到表面上来的显明的东西，恰恰在其中就是最深的东西。
那最高的本质被看见、被听见、等等，被看作一个存在着的自我意识——这事实上就是它的概念的完成；并且通过这种完成，本质就如其为本质那样直接地在场了。

en: This immediate determinate being is at the same time not solely and not merely immediate consciousness, but it is religious consciousness; the immediacy has, undivided, the significance not only of an existent self-consciousness, but of the purely thought, or absolute, essence.
What we are conscious of in our concept, that being is essence — of this the religious consciousness is conscious.

This unity of being and essence, of thinking that is immediate determinate being, is, as it is the thought of this religious consciousness or its mediated knowledge, equally its immediate knowledge; for this unity of being and thinking is self-consciousness and is itself present, or the thought unity has at the same time this shape of what it is.
God is therefore here manifest as he is; he is present as he is in himself; he is present as spirit.
God is attainable only in pure speculative knowledge, and is only in it, and is only it itself; for he is spirit, and this speculative knowledge is the knowledge of revealed religion.

The former knows him as thinking, or as pure essence, and this thinking as being and as determinate being, and determinate being as the negativity of itself, hence as self, as this self and as the universal self; precisely this is what revealed religion knows.

– The hopes and expectations of the preceding world pressed onward solely to this revelation, to behold what the absolute essence is, and to find themselves in it; this joy becomes self-consciousness and seizes the whole world, to behold itself in the absolute essence; for it is spirit, it is the simple movement of those pure moments which themselves express this: that the essence is known as spirit only through the fact that it is intuited as an immediate self-consciousness.
zh: 这种直接的定在同时不只是、也不单纯是直接的意识，而是宗教的意识；这种直接性不可分割地具有的意义，不仅是一个存在着的自我意识，而且是纯粹被思维的本质、或者说绝对本质。
