我们在自己的概念中所意识到的东西，即存在就是本质，宗教的意识也意识到了。
存在与本质的这种统一、即那种作为直接的定在的思维的统一，正如它是这个宗教的意识的思想、或者说它的中介了的知识，它同样也是它的直接的知识；因为存在与思维的这种统一就是自我意识，而且它本身就在场，或者说，被思维了的统一同时具有它所是的东西的这种形态。
因此，上帝在这里就是显明的，正如他所是的那样；他如此地在场，正如他自在所是的那样；他作为精神而在场。
上帝只有在纯粹的思辨知识中才是可达到的，并且他只在这种知识之中，并且他仅仅是这种知识本身；因为他是精神，而这种思辨知识就是天启宗教的知识。
前者把他知道为思维、或者说纯粹本质，并把这种思维知道为存在和定在，把定在知道为它自身的否定性，从而知道为自我，知道为这个自我和普遍的自我；天启宗教所知道的恰恰就是这个。
——先前世界的希望和期待，都单单涌向这一启示，去直观那绝对本质是什么，并在它里面找到自己；这种喜悦成为自我意识，并抓住了整个世界，在绝对本质中观看自身；因为它是精神，它是那些纯粹环节的简单运动，这些环节本身就表达着：本质正是由于作为直接的自我意识被直观，才作为精神而被知道。

en: This concept of the spirit that knows itself as spirit is itself still the immediate one and not yet developed.

The essence is spirit, or it has appeared, it is manifest; this first being-manifest is itself immediate, but the immediacy is just as much pure mediation or thinking; it must therefore present this at itself as such.

– Considered more determinately, spirit in the immediacy of self-consciousness is this individual self-consciousness, opposed to the universal; it is an excluding One, which, for the consciousness for which it is present, still has the unresolved form of a sensuous other; this consciousness does not yet know spirit as its own, or spirit is not yet present, as it is as an individual self, equally as universal, as all self.

Or the shape does not yet have the form of the concept, i.e. of the universal self, of the self which, in its immediate actuality, is equally the sublated, thinking, universality, without losing that in this.

– But the next, and itself immediate, form of this universality is not yet the form of thinking itself, of the concept as concept, but the universality of actuality, the allness of selves, and the elevation of determinate being into representation — as everywhere; and, to cite a determinate example, the sublated sensuous “this” is only the thing of perception, not yet the universal of the understanding.
zh: 这个知道自己本身就是精神的精神的概念，本身还是直接的、还没有展开的。
本质就是精神，或者说它已经显现了，它是显明的；这第一个显明存在本身是直接的，但这种直接性同样也是纯粹的中介、或者说思维；因此，它必须在它自身那里、作为这样的东西，把这一点呈现出来。
——更确定地来看这一点，那么精神在自我意识的直接性中就是这个个别的自我意识，它同普遍的自我意识相对立；他是排他的一，对于那个它为其而在场的意识来说，他还具有一个感性的他者的尚未消解的形式；这个意识还不知道精神就是它自己的精神，或者说，精神还不像它作为个别自我那样，同样也作为普遍的、作为一切自我而在场。
或者说，形态还不具有概念的形式，即普遍的自我的形式，即那种自我的形式——这种自我在它的直接现实中同样是被扬弃的、是思维、是普遍性，却并不在这种普遍性中失去那种直接的现实性。
——但这种普遍性的下一个、本身还是直接的形态，还并不是思维本身的形式、并不是概念作为概念的形式，而是现实性的普遍性、自我的全体性、以及定在向表象中的提升——这到处都是如此；并且，举一个确定的例子来说，被扬弃了的感性的这一个还只是知觉的物，还不是知性的普遍者。

en: This individual human being, then, as which the absolute essence is manifest, performs on him, as an individual, the movement of sensuous being.
He is the immediately present God; thereby his being passes over into having-been.

The consciousness for which he has this sensuous presence ceases to see and to hear him; it has seen and heard him; and only through the fact that it has only seen and heard him does it itself become spiritual consciousness; or, as he previously arose for it as sensuous determinate being, he has now arisen in spirit.

– For as that which sensuously sees and hears him, it is itself only immediate consciousness, which has not sublated the inequality of objectivity, has not taken it back into pure thinking, but knows this objective individual, not itself as spirit.

In the vanishing of the immediate determinate being of what is known as absolute essence, the immediate receives its negative moment; spirit remains the immediate self of actuality, but as the universal self-consciousness of the community, which rests in its own substance, just as this substance is in it universal subject; not the individual for itself, but together with the consciousness of the community, and what he is for the community is the complete whole of it.
zh: 因此，这个别的人——绝对本质作为他而显明——在他这个个别者身上完成着感性的存在的运动。
他就是那个直接现前的上帝；由此，他的存在就过渡为曾经存在。
那个对他拥有这种感性现前的意识，不再看见他、听见他了；它已经看见过他、听见过他；而只是由于它只看见过、听见过他，它本身才成为精神的意识；或者说，正如他先前作为感性的定在为它而起，他现在是在精神中起来了。
——因为作为那个感性地看他、听他的东西，它本身只是直接的意识，这种意识没有扬弃对象性的不对等，没有把这种对象性收回到纯粹思维之中，而是只知道这个对象性的个别者，却不知道它自己就是精神。
在那被知道为绝对本质的东西的直接定在的消失中，直接的东西获得它的否定性的环节；精神始终是现实性的直接的自我，但这是作为教团的普遍自我意识，这种自我意识在它自己的实体中安息，正如这实体在它里面是普遍的主体；不是那个个体自为地，而是同教团的意识在一起，并且他对于教团所是的东西，就是教团的完全的整体。

en: Past and distance, however, are only the imperfect form in which the immediate mode is mediated, or posited as universal; this has merely been dipped superficially into the element of thinking, is preserved therein as a sensuous mode, and is not united with the nature of thinking itself.
It is only elevated into representation, for this is the synthetic connection of sensuous immediacy and its universality, or of thinking.
zh: 但是，过去和距离只是那种直接的方式被中介、或者说被设定为普遍的东西时所具有的不完满的形式；这种方式只是表面地浸入过思维的要素，作为感性的方式保存在其中，并没有同思维本身的本性合而为一。
它只是被提升到表象之中，因为表象就是感性的直接性同它的普遍性、或者说同思维的综合的联系。

en: This form of representing constitutes the determinacy in which the spirit, in this its community, becomes conscious of itself.
It is not yet the self-consciousness of the same that has advanced to its concept as concept; the mediation is still incomplete.
There is therefore, in this connection of being and thinking, the deficiency that the spiritual essence is still afflicted with an unreconciled diremption into a this-side and a beyond.

The content is the true, but all its moments, posited in the element of representing, have the character of not being comprehended, but of appearing as perfectly independent sides which relate to one another externally.

For the true content to acquire its true form for consciousness as well, the higher formation of the latter is necessary: to raise its intuition of the absolute substance into the concept, and, for consciousness itself, to equalize its consciousness with its self-consciousness, as this has come to pass for us or in itself.
zh: 表象的这种形态构成规定性，精神在自己的这个教团里正是在这种规定性中意识到自身的。
它还不是精神那种已经上升到自己的概念、并作为概念而成立的自我意识；中介还没有完成。
因此，在这个存在与思维的联结中就有这样一个缺陷：精神性本质还带着一种未得和解的分裂，分成此岸和彼岸。
内容是真的，但它的所有环节，由于被置于表象这个要素之中，都带有这样的性质：不是以概念被把握的，而是显现为完全独立的方面，这些方面彼此只是外在地相互关联。
真的内容也要为意识取得它真的形式，为此就需要后者的更高教养：把对绝对实体的直观提升到概念，并为意识自身把它的意识同它的自我意识拉平，就像这已经对我们、或自在地发生了的那样。

en: This content is to be considered in the way in which it is in its consciousness.
The absolute spirit is content; as such it is in the shape of its truth.

But its truth is not only to be the substance of the community, or the in-itself of the same, nor only to rise out of this inwardness into the objectivity of representing, but to become the actual self, to reflect itself into itself, and to be subject.
This, then, is the movement which it accomplishes in its community, or this is the life of the same.

What this self-revealing spirit is in and for itself is therefore not brought out by unwinding, as it were, its rich life in the community and leading it back to its first thread — say, to the representations of the first imperfect community, or even to what the actual human being has spoken.
This leading-back is grounded in the instinct to go to the concept; but it confuses the origin, as the immediate determinate being of the first appearance, with the simplicity of the concept.

Through this impoverishment of the life of spirit, through the removal of the representation of the community and of its deed in favor of its representation, there arises therefore, instead of the concept, rather the mere externality and singularity, the historical manner of the immediate appearance, and the spiritless recollection of a single intended shape and its past.
zh: 这个内容要按它在自己的意识里存在的那种方式来考察。
绝对精神是内容，既然如此，它就处在它的真理的形态中。
但它的真理并不只是充当教团的实体、或教团的自在，也不只是从这种内在性中上升、进入表象的对象性，而是成为现实的自我，在自身中反观自身，并成为主体。
所以这就是它在自己的教团里完成的运动，或者说，这就是它的生命。
因此，这个自我显明的精神自在自为地是什么，并不能这样得出来：仿佛把它在教团中丰富的生活重新倒开、拉回到最初的那根线——比如拉回到最初那个不完善的教团的表象，或者甚至拉回到那个现实的人说过的话。
这种拉回到起源的做法，其底下的本能是要走向概念；但它把起源——即最初那个现象的直接定在——同概念的单纯性混为一谈。
通过这种对精神生命的贫困化，通过把教团的表象和它的行动清除掉、换成对它的表象，产生的就不是概念，而只是纯粹的外在性和个别性，即直接现象的历史方式，以及对一个被意指的单一形态及其过去的无精神的回忆。

en: Spirit is the content of its consciousness first in the form of the pure substance, or is the content of its pure consciousness.
This element of thinking is the movement of descending to determinate being, or to singularity.

The middle between them is their synthetic connection, the consciousness of becoming-other, or representing as such; the third is the return out of representation and otherness, or the element of self-consciousness itself.
These three moments constitute the spirit; its parting-asunder in representation consists in being in a determinate manner; but this determinacy is nothing other than one of its moments.

Its elaborated movement is therefore this: to spread out its nature in each of its moments as in an element; and as each of these circles completes itself within itself, this its reflection-into-self is at the same time the transition into the other.

Representing constitutes the middle between pure thinking and self-consciousness as such, and is only one of the determinacies; but at the same time, as has been shown, its character is to be the synthetic connection, spread out over all these elements and their common determinacy.
zh: 精神首先是纯粹实体这一形式下的自己意识的内容，或者说，是它的纯粹意识的内容。
思维的这个要素就是下降、降到定在或个别性中去的运动。
它们之间的中项是它们的综合的联系，即变成他者的意识，或者说表象本身；第三者是从表象和他在中返回，或者说就是自我意识的要素本身。
这三个环节构成精神；它在表象中的分开，就在于它以某种特定的方式存在；但这种规定性不是别的，正是它的一个环节。
所以它的展开的运动就是这样：在自己的每一个环节里、如同在一个要素中展开自己的本性；这些圆圈中的每一个都在自身中完成自己，这种向自身内的反思同时就是向另一个的过渡。
表象构成纯粹思维和自我意识本身之间的中项，只是规定性之一；但同时，如已经表明的，它的性质就是：做综合的联系，这种联系散布在所有这些要素之上，并且是它们共同的规定性。

en: The content itself, which is to be considered, has partly already come up as the representation of the unhappy and the believing consciousness — in the former, however, in the determination of a content produced out of consciousness and longed for, in which spirit can neither sate itself nor find rest, because it does not yet have its content in itself, or as its substance; in the latter, on the other hand, it has been regarded as the selfless essence of the world, or as the essentially objective content of representing — of a representing that flees actuality in general and is therefore without the certainty of self-consciousness, which partly separates itself from it as the vanity of knowing, partly as pure insight.
The consciousness of the community, on the other hand, has it as its substance, just as it is their certainty of their own spirit.
zh: 这个要加以考察的内容本身，有一部分已经作为苦恼意识和信仰的意识的表象出现过了——但它在苦恼意识那里，具有这样一种规定：它是从意识中产生出来、并令人渴求的内容，精神在这个内容中既不能饱足，也不能安息，因为这个内容还没有自在地、或作为它的实体而是精神自己的内容；相反，在信仰的意识那里，这个内容则被看作世界的无自我的本质，或看作本质上客观的表象内容——这样一种表象整个地逃避现实性，因而没有自我意识的确定性，而自我意识的确定性部分地作为知识的虚妄、部分地作为纯粹识见同它分离。
而教团的意识则把它当作自己的实体，正如它就是教团对自己精神的确定性。

en: Spirit, first represented as substance in the element of pure thinking, is thereby immediately the simple, self-identical, eternal essence, which, however, does not have this abstract meaning of essence, but the meaning of the absolute spirit.
But spirit is this, not to be a meaning, not the inward, but the actual.
The simple eternal essence would therefore be spirit only in the empty sense of the word, if it remained at the representation and the expression of the simple eternal essence.

But the simple essence, because it is the abstraction, is in fact the negative in itself, namely the negativity of thinking, or the negative as it is in the essence in itself; that is, it is the absolute difference from itself, or its pure becoming-other.
As essence it is only in itself, or for us; but since this purity is just the abstraction, or negativity, it is for itself itself, or the self, the concept.
It is thus objective; and since representing apprehends and utters the necessity of the concept just expressed as an event, it will be said that the eternal essence begets an other.

But in this otherness it has just as immediately returned into itself; for the difference is the difference in itself; that is, it is immediately distinguished only from itself; it is thus the unity returned into itself.
zh: 精神首先在纯粹思维的要素中作为实体被表象出来，因此它直接就是那单纯的、自身等同的、永恒的本质；但这本质具有的不是本质的这个抽象含义，而是绝对精神的含义。
然而精神是这样一个东西：不是含义，不是内在的东西，而是现实的东西。
因此，那单纯的永恒本质如果停留在对单纯永恒本质的表象和言说上，它就只是就空洞的词来说才是精神。
然而单纯本质既然就是抽象，它在事实上就是自身中的否定者，即思维的否定性，或者说，就是本质自身中那个否定者；这就是说，它就是与自身的绝对差别，即它的纯粹的变成他者。
作为本质，它只是自在地、或只是为我们而存在；但由于这种纯粹性正是抽象、或否定性，它就是为自身而存在的，或者说就是自我，就是概念。
所以它是对象性的；而由于表象把刚刚说出来的概念的必然性当作一个发生的事情来把握并说出来，于是人们就会说，永恒本质产生出一个他者。
但在这个他在中，它同样直接地已经返回到自身中；因为这种差别是自在的差别；这就是说，它直接只是自己同自己相区别，所以它就是在自身中返回了的统一。

en: There are thus three moments that distinguish themselves: that of essence; that of being-for-self, which is the otherness of essence and for which essence is; and that of being-for-self, or of self-knowing, in the other.

Essence contemplates only itself in its being-for-self; in this externalization it is only with itself; the being-for-self that excludes itself from essence is the knowledge that essence has of itself; it is the word, which, once uttered, externalizes the one who utters it and leaves him emptied behind, but is equally immediately heard, and only this hearing-of-itself is the determinate being of the word.

So that the distinctions that are made are dissolved just as immediately as they are made, and are made just as immediately as they are dissolved, and the true and the actual is precisely this movement circling within itself.
zh: 因此区别开来的，是这三个环节：本质的环节；自为存在的环节——它是本质的他在，而本质就是为它而在的——；以及自为存在、或者说在他在中自己知道自己的环节。
本质在自己的自为存在中只静观它自身；在这种外化中它只与自己在一起；那个把自己从本质中排斥出来的自为存在，就是本质对它自己的知识；它就是话语，话语一说出来，就把那说话的人外化，把他抽空之后撂在一边，但它同样直接地被听到；并且只有这种对自己本身的听到，才是话语的定在。
以至于那些被做出来的区别，恰恰在它们被做出来的同一瞬间就被消解，也同样恰恰在它们被消解的同一瞬间又被做出来；真的东西和现实的东西，恰恰就是这个在自身之内回旋的运动。

en: This movement within itself expresses absolute essence as spirit; absolute essence that is not comprehended as spirit is merely the abstract void, just as spirit that is not comprehended as this movement is merely an empty word.
Inasmuch as its moments are grasped in their purity, they are the restless concepts, whose being is merely to be their own opposite within themselves and to have their rest in the whole.

But the representing of the congregation is not this comprehending thinking; it has the content without its necessity and, instead of the form of the concept, brings the natural relations of father and son into the realm of pure consciousness.

In that it thus comports itself representationally within thinking itself, essence is indeed manifest to it; but because of this synthetic representing, the moments of essence partly fall asunder of themselves, so that they do not relate to one another through their own concept, and partly it draws back from this its pure object and relates only externally to it; this object is revealed to it by a stranger, and in this thought of spirit it does not recognize itself, does not recognize the nature of pure self-consciousness.

Insofar as it is necessary to go beyond the form of representing and those relations that are drawn from the natural, and hence especially also beyond taking the moments of the movement that spirit is for isolated, unwavering substances or subjects instead of for transitional moments, this going-beyond is, as was recalled earlier on another side, to be regarded as a pressure of the concept; but since it is only instinct, it misjudges itself, throws away the content along with the form and, what is the same thing, demotes it to a historical representation and an heirloom of tradition; herein only the purely external element of faith is retained, and indeed as something dead and devoid of cognition; but its inwardness has vanished, because this would be the concept that knows itself as concept.
zh: 这个在自身之内的运动，把绝对本质表述为精神；那没有作为精神被以概念把握的绝对本质，只是抽象的空洞，正如那没有作为这个运动被以概念把握的精神，只是空话。
当它的环节在它们的纯粹性中被把握时，它们就是些不安的概念；它们的存在仅仅是：在自身之中就是自己的对立面，并在整体中拥有自己的安宁。
但是，教团的表象并不是这种以概念把握的思维；它拥有内容，却不拥有内容的必然性；它不用概念的形式，反而把父亲与儿子的自然关系搬进纯粹意识的王国。
它既然在思维本身中就这样以表象的方式行事，本质对它固然就是公开的；但由于这种综合的表象，本质的环节一方面自行散开，以至于它们不是通过自己的概念而互相关联结，另一方面它又从这个它自己的纯粹对象那里退回来，只同它发生外在的关系；这个对象是一个陌生人向它启示出来的，而在这个关于精神的思想中，它认识不到它自己本身，认识不到纯粹的自我意识的本性。

既然必须超出表象的形式和那些取自自然的关系，并从而特别是必须不再把那场作为精神而存在的运动的环节当作孤立的、不动摇的实体或主体，而当作过渡着的环节，那么，这种超出——正如前面在另一方面已经提醒过的——就应当看作概念的逼迫；但是，既然它只是本能，它就误解了自己，把形式和内容一起抛掉，也就是说，把内容降格为一种历史性的表象、降格为传统的遗产；在这里，信仰那纯粹外在的东西只是被保留了下来，而且是作为无认识的死物被保留下来；但它的内在东西却消失了，因为这种东西就是那个把自己作为概念来知道的概念。

en: Absolute spirit, represented in pure essence, is indeed not the abstract pure essence; rather, the latter has sunk to the level of an element precisely by being only a moment within spirit.
The presentation of spirit in this element, however, has in itself the same defect with respect to form that essence has as essence.

Essence is the abstract and therefore the negative of its simplicity, an other; likewise spirit in the element of essence is the form of simple unity, which is therefore just as essentially a becoming-other.

– Or, what is the same thing, the relation of the eternal essence to its being-for-self is the immediately simple one of pure thinking; in this simple intuiting of itself in the other, otherness is therefore not posited as such; it is difference as it is in pure thinking, immediately no difference; a recognizing of love, in which the two do not oppose themselves to one another according to their essence.

– Spirit that is expressed in the element of pure thinking is essentially itself this: to be not merely within it, but actual; for in its concept lies otherness itself, that is, the sublation of the pure, merely thought concept.
zh: 那在纯粹本质中被表象的绝对精神，固然不是那个抽象的纯粹本质；相反，纯粹本质正因为它在精神中只是一个环节，才降格为元素。
但精神在这个元素中的表现，在形式上本身就带有本质作为本质所具有的同一个缺陷。
本质是抽象的东西，因而是它的单纯性的否定，是一个他在；同样，处在本质的元素中的精神，是单纯统一的形式，因而它同样本质上就是一个变成他在。
——或者说，这是一回事：永恒本质对它自己的自为存在所保持的关系，是纯粹思维那直接而单纯的关系；因此，在这个在他在中对自身的单纯直观中，他在本身并没有被建立起来；它是差别，就像它在纯粹思维中直接地不是差别一样；这是一种爱的承认，在其中双方并不按照它们的本质而互相对立。
——那在纯粹思维的元素中被表达出来的精神，本质上本身就是这个：不仅存在于这个元素之中，而且是现实地存在的；因为，在它的概念里本身就有着他在，也就是说，有着对那个纯粹的、仅仅被思想的概念的扬弃。

en: The element of pure thinking, because it is the abstract, is itself rather the other of its simplicity and therefore passes over into the proper element of representation – the element in which the moments of the pure concept preserve a substantial determinate being equally over against one another, as they are subjects which do not have the indifference of being over against one another for a third, but, reflected into themselves, separate themselves from one another and set themselves in opposition.
zh: 纯粹思维的元素，正因为它是抽象的东西，本身反倒是它的单纯性的他在，并因此过渡到表象的真正元素——在这个元素里，纯粹概念的环节互相对等地保有一种实体性的定在，正如它们是些主体；这些主体并不是为了一个第三者才互相对等地具有那种存在的漠不相干，而是返回到自身之内，自行互相分离开来并对立起来。

en: The spirit that is thus merely eternal or abstract becomes itself an other, or enters into determinate being, and immediately into immediate determinate being.
It therefore creates a world.

This creating is the word of representation for the concept itself in its absolute movement, or for the fact that the simple, or pure thinking, that is declared absolute, because it is the abstract, is rather the negative and hence the self-opposed other; – or because, to say the same thing in yet another form, what is posited as essence is simple immediacy or being, but lacks immediacy or being of the self and is therefore, devoid of inwardness, passive or a being for another.

– This being for another is at the same time a world; spirit in the determination of being for another is the quiet subsistence of the moments previously enclosed in pure thinking, hence the dissolution of their simple universality and their going apart into their own particularity.
zh: 因此，这个仅仅永恒的、或抽象的精神，就使自己成为一个他在，或者说进入定在，直接地进入直接的定在。
因此，它创造出一个世界。
这个创造就是表象用来表达概念本身按其绝对运动的词语，或者说，是用来表达这一点：那个被陈述为绝对的单纯东西、即纯粹思维，正因为它是抽象的东西，反倒是否定性，从而是与自己相对立的他在；——或者说，用另一种形式把同一件事情再说一次：那被设立为本质的东西，是单纯的直接性或存在，但它作为自我的直接性或存在却是缺乏的，因而由于缺少内在性，它就是被动的，就是为他存在。
——这个为他存在同时就是一个世界；处在为他存在这一规定之中的精神，就是前面那些被封闭在纯粹思维中的环节的安静持存，因而是它们那单纯的普遍性的消解，是它们分头走进自己的特殊性。

en: The world, however, is not merely this spirit thrown apart into completeness and its external order; rather, since it is essentially the simple self, this is equally present in it: the existing spirit, which is the individual self, which has consciousness and distinguishes itself from itself as other, or as world.
– Just as this individual self is thus immediately posited, it is not yet spirit for itself; it is thus not as spirit; it can be called innocent, but hardly good.
In order to be in fact self and spirit, it must first become an other to itself, just as the eternal essence represents itself as the movement of being equal to itself in its otherness.
In that this spirit is determined as first immediately existing, or as dispersed into the multiplicity of its consciousness, its becoming-other is the going-into-itself of knowing in general.

Immediate determinate being turns over into thought, or the merely sensuous consciousness into the consciousness of thought; and indeed, because it is the thought that comes from immediacy, the conditioned thought, it is not pure knowing, but the thought that has otherness within it, and hence the thought of good and evil that is opposed to itself.

Man is thus represented such that it happened as something not necessary, – that he lost the form of self-sameness through the picking from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil and was driven out of the state of innocent consciousness, out of the nature that proffers itself without labor, and out of paradise, the garden of the animals.
zh: 但是，世界并不只是这个被抛散成完备性及其外在秩序的精神；因为它本质上就是单纯的自我，所以这个自我也同样地在它上面在场：即那个存在着的、作为个体自我的精神；个体自我拥有意识，并把自己与自己区别开来，区别为他在、区别为世界。
——正如这个个体自我才这样直接地被设立起来，它还还不是自为的精神；因此它不是作为精神而存在；它可以被称作无辜的，但很难被称作善的。
为了事实上就是自我和精神，它必须首先使自己成为一个他在，正如永恒本质把自己表现为那个在自己的他在中与自己相等的运动一样。
既然这个精神被规定为最初直接存在着的、或被分散到它的意识的多重性之中的，那么它的变成他就是一般知识的返回自身。
直接的定在翻转成思想，那仅仅感性的意识翻转成关于思想的意识；并且，正因为它那来自直接性的、即有条件的思想，它就不是纯粹的知识，而是在自己身上带有他在的思想，因而是那与自己相对立的善与恶的思想。
人被这样表象：事情的发生是作为某种并非必然的东西——他因为从善恶认识之树上采摘而失去了自我等同的形式，并被从那无辜的意识的状态、从那不劳而获地自我奉献的自然、从那乐园、那动物的花园中驱逐了出来。

en: In that this going-into-itself of existing consciousness immediately determines itself as becoming unequal to itself, evil appears as the first determinate being of the consciousness that has gone into itself; and because the thoughts of good and evil are absolutely opposed and this opposition is not yet dissolved, this consciousness is essentially only the evil one.
At the same time, however, precisely because of this opposition, the good consciousness is also present over against it, and so is their relation to one another.

– Insofar as immediate determinate being turns over into thought and being-within-self is partly itself thinking, partly thereby determines the moment of the becoming-other of essence more closely, the becoming-evil can be shifted further back, out of the existing world, into the very first realm of thought.
It can therefore be said that already the firstborn son of light, in going into himself, was the one who fell away, but that in his place another was at once produced.

Such a form as falling away, or as son, which belongs merely to representation and not to the concept, just as much conversely degrades the moments of the concept down into representation, or carries representation over into the realm of thought.
– It is just as indifferent to attach to the simple thought of otherness in the eternal essence a multiplicity of other shapes and to relocate the going-into-itself into these shapes.

This co-ordination must therefore at the same time be approved, because in this way this moment of otherness, as it is meant to, at once expresses difference, and indeed not as multiplicity in general, but at once as determinate difference: so that the one part, the son, is the simple being that knows itself as essence, while the other part is the externalization of being-for-self, which lives only in the worth of essence; into this part, then, can again be placed the taking back of the externalized being-for-self and the going-into-itself of evil.

Insofar as otherness falls into two, spirit would be more determinate in its moments and, if they were counted, expressed as a four-in-one, or – because the multitude again itself falls into two parts, namely into those that remained good and those that became evil – even as a five-in-one.

– Counting the moments, however, can in general be regarded as useless, partly because the differentiated itself is just as much only one, namely just the thought of difference, which is only a thought insofar as it is this differentiated one, the second over against the first; but partly also because the thought that grasps the many in one must be dissolved out of its universality and distinguished into more than three or four differentiated ones, – a universality which, against the absolute determinacy of the abstract one, the principle of number, appears as an indeterminacy in relation to number itself, so that the question could only be of numbers in general, that is, not of a determinate number of the differences; hence to think here of number and counting at all is entirely superfluous, just as elsewhere the mere difference of magnitude and multitude is conceptless and meaningless.
zh: 既然存在着的意识这个返回自身直接把自己规定为与自己变得不相等，那么恶就显现为这个已返回自身的意识的最初定在；并且，因为善的思想和恶的思想是全然对立着的，而这种对立还没有被消解，所以这个意识本质上就只是恶的。
但同时，恰恰由于这种对立，善的意识也作为它的对立面而在场，并且它们相互之间的关系也在场。
——既然直接的定在翻转为思想，而自身内存在一部分本身就是思维，一部分由此更确切地规定了本质的变成他这一环节，那么，变恶就可以进一步从存在着的世界中退回到那思维的第一个王国里去。
因此可以说，那头生的光明之子，在返回自身之际就是那个堕落者；但在他的位置上立刻又产生了另一个。
像“堕落”、还有“儿子”这类仅仅属于表象、而不属于概念的形式，同样反过来把概念的环节降格到表象里，或者说把表象搬进思想的王国。
——同样无所谓的是：给永恒本质中他在的那个单纯思想再配上一批别的形态，并把返回自身搬到这些形态里去。
因此，这种配合同时又必须得到认可，因为由此，他在这个环节就如其应当地同时表达出差别，而且不是作为一般的众多，而是同时作为规定的差别：这样，一个部分、即儿子，是那单纯的、把自己作为本质来知的东西，另一个部分则是自为存在的外化，这个外化只靠着本质的价值而活着；那么，把那外化了的自为存在重新收回来、把那恶的返回自身，也又可以放到这个部分里去。
既然他在分裂为二，那么精神在它的环节中就会更确切些，并且，如果给它们点数，就会被表达为四位一体，或者——因为这个众多本身又分裂为两部分，即保持善的和变成恶的——甚至被表达为五位一体。

——不过，给这些环节点数，总的说来可以看作是无用的；这一方面是因为，那被区别开的东西本身同样只是一个，即恰恰就是差别的思想；这个思想只要它是这个被区别者、即与第一个相对峙的第二个，就只是一个思想；另一方面是因为，那把多把握为一的思想必须从它的普遍性中展开出来，被区别为多于三个或四个被区别者——这种普遍性相对于抽象的一、即数字之原则的绝对规定性，就表现为相对于数字本身的不规定性，以至于这里谈得到的只能是一般的数字，也就是说，不是差别的一个确定数目；因此，在这里去一般地想着数字和点数，根本就是多余的，正如在别处，大小和众多的单纯差别也是无概念的、无意义的。

en: The good and the evil were the determinate differences of thought that resulted.

Since their opposition has not yet dissolved, and they are represented as essences of thought, each of which is independent for itself, the human being is the essenceless self and the synthetic ground of their determinate being and their struggle.
But these universal powers belong just as much to the self, or the self is their actuality.

According to this moment, it thus happens that, just as evil is nothing other than the going-into-itself of the natural determinate being of spirit, conversely the good enters into actuality and appears as an existent self-consciousness.

– What in the purely thought spirit was merely indicated as the becoming-other of the divine essence in general, here comes closer to its realization for representation; for representation, this realization consists in the self-abasement of the divine essence, which renounces its abstraction and unreality.

– The other side, evil, representation takes as an event foreign to the divine essence; to grasp it in the divine essence itself, as its wrath, is the highest, hardest exertion of the representation wrestling with itself, which, since it lacks the concept, remains fruitless.
zh: 善与恶曾是思想的特定的差别，这些差别是自己产生出来的。
由于它们的对立还没有消解，并且它们作为思想的本质被表象出来——它们每一个都自为地是独立的——，所以人就是无本质的自我，就是它们的定在和斗争的综合的基地。
但是，这些普遍的力量也同样属于自我，或者说，自我就是它们的现实性。
因此，按照这个环节来看，事情就成了这样：正如恶不是别的、只是精神的那种自然的定在的返回自身，反过来，善就进入现实性，并作为一个存在着的自我意识而显现。
——那在纯粹被思维的精神中只是作为神性本质一般的变成他而被暗示了一下的东西，在这里就为表象而逼近了它的实现；这种实现在表象看来就在于神性本质的自我贬低，神性本质放弃它的抽象和非现实性。
——另一边、即恶，表象把它当作一种对神性本质而言陌生的事件；在神性本质本身之中、作为它的愤怒来把握恶，这就是那个同自身搏斗的表象的最高、最艰苦的努力；这种努力由于缺少概念，就毫无结果。

en: The estrangement of the divine essence is thus posited in its doubled manner; the self of spirit and its simple thought are the two moments whose absolute unity is spirit itself; its estrangement consists in this, that they fall apart and the one has an unequal value over against the other.
This inequality is therefore the doubled one, and two connections arise whose common moments are the ones indicated.

In the one, the divine essence counts as the essential, but the natural determinate being and the self as the unessential and as what is to be sublated; in the other, by contrast, being-for-self counts as the essential and the simple divine as the unessential.
Their still empty middle is determinate being in general, the mere commonality of the two moments of the same.
zh: 因此，神性本质的异化就以它那双重的方式被设定起来了；精神的自我和它的简单的思想就是那两个环节，它们的绝对的统一就是精神本身；它的异化就在于：这两个环节分离开来，并且一方具有一个同另一方不相等的价值。
因此，这种不相等就是双重的，并产生出两种结合，它们的共同的环节就是上面指出的那些环节。
在一种结合中，神性本质算作本质性的东西，而自然的定在和自我则算作非本质性的、应当被扬弃的东西；在另一种结合中，反过来，自为存在算作本质性的东西，而单纯的神性则算作非本质性的东西。
它们那还空着的中项就是一般的定在，也就是这两个环节在两种结合中的单纯共同性。

en: The dissolution of this opposition does not come about so much through the struggle of the two, which are represented as separated and independent essences.

In their independence it lies that each, in itself, through its concept, must dissolve itself in itself; the struggle falls only there, where both cease to be these mixtures of thought and independent determinate being, and where they stand over against one another only as thoughts.

For then, as determinate concepts, they are essentially only in the opposed relation; as independent, by contrast, they have their essentiality outside the opposition; their movement is thus the free and proper one of themselves.

Thus, just as the movement of both is the movement in itself, because it is to be considered in them themselves, so it is also begun by that one of the two which is determined as the in-itself-existent over against the other.

This is represented as a voluntary doing; but the necessity of its externalization lies in the concept, that the in-itself-existent, which is determined thus only in the opposition, for that very reason does not have true subsistence; – thus it is that for which not being-for-self, but the simple, counts as the essence, which externalizes itself, goes into death, and thereby reconciles the absolute essence with itself.

For in this movement it presents itself as spirit; the abstract essence is estranged from itself, it has natural determinate being and self-like actuality; this its otherness, or its sensuous presence, is taken back through the second becoming-other and posited as sublated, as universal; thereby the essence has become itself within it; the immediate determinate being of actuality has ceased to be something foreign or external to it, in that it is sublated, universal; this death is therefore its rising again as spirit.
zh: 这个对立的消解，主要并不是通过那两者的斗争而发生的——那两者被表象为分离的、独立的本质。
在它们的独立性中包含着这样一点：每一个都自在地、通过它的概念，必须在它自身那里消解自己；斗争才落到那样的地方：两者不再是这样一些思维和独立定在的混合，而是只作为思想相互对立。
因为这时，作为特定的概念，它们本质上只在对立的关系之中；而作为独立者，它们在对立之外还拥有它们的本质性；所以，它们的运动就是它们自身的、自由的运动。
因此，正如两者的运动就是自在的运动，因为这运动应当在它们自身那里加以考察，这运动也就由两者中的那一个开始——那一个被规定为同另一个相对立的自在存在者。
这在表象中被看作一种自愿的行动；但它的外化的必然性却在于概念之中：那个只在对立中才如此被规定的自在存在者，正因此就不具有真正的持存；——所以，就是这样一方，对它来说算作本质的不是自为存在，而是单纯的东西，它自己外化自己、走入死亡，并由此使绝对本质同它本身和解。
因为在这种运动中，它把自己表现为精神；那抽象的本质自身异化了，它拥有自然的定在和自我性的现实性；它的这个他在、或者说它的感性的在场，通过第二次变成他而被收回来，并被设定为被扬弃的东西、被设定为普遍的东西；本质由此就在它里面成为了它自己；现实性的直接定在已经不再是一种对它而言陌生的或外在的东西，因为它就是被扬弃的、普遍的东西；所以，这个死就是它作为精神而复活。

en: The sublated immediate presence of the self-conscious essence is it as universal self-consciousness; this concept of the sublated individual self, which is absolute essence, therefore directly expresses the constitution of a community, which, having previously remained in representation, now returns into itself, as into the self; and spirit thus passes over from the second element of its determination, representation, into the third, self-consciousness as such.
– If we still consider the manner in which that representation comports itself in its progress, we see first this expressed, that the divine essence assumes human nature.

Therein it is already expressed that in themselves both are not separated; as therein, that the divine essence externalizes itself from the beginning, goes its determinate being into itself and becomes evil, it is not expressed, but therein contained, that in itself this evil determinate being is not something foreign to it; the absolute essence would have only this empty name, if in truth there were an other for it, if there were a falling away from it; – the moment of being-in-self constitutes rather the essential moment of the self of spirit.

– That being-in-self, and thereby actuality in the first place, belongs to the essence itself, this, which is concept for us and in so far as it is concept, appears to the representing consciousness as an event that cannot be comprehended by the concept; the in-itself assumes the form of indifferent being for it.

The thought, however, that those moments of the absolute essence and of the being-for-self self which seem to flee one another are not separated, appears to this representation also — for it possesses the true content — but only afterward, in the externalization of the divine essence, that essence becomes flesh.

This representation, which in this way is still immediate and therefore not spiritual, or which knows the human shape of the essence only as a particular, not yet universal, one, becomes spiritual for this consciousness in the movement of the shaped essence, namely to sacrifice again its immediate determinate being and to return to the essence; the essence as reflected into itself is first spirit.
– The reconciliation of the divine essence with the other in general, and determinately with the thought of it, evil, is thus represented herein.

– If this reconciliation is expressed according to its concept in such a way that it consists in this, that in itself evil is the same as the good, or also the divine essence the same as nature in its whole extent, just as nature, separated from the divine essence, is only nothing, – then this is to be regarded as an unspiritual manner of expressing itself, which must necessarily arouse misunderstandings.

– In that evil is the same as the good, evil is precisely not evil, nor the good good, but rather both are sublated, evil in general being the in-self-existent being-for-self, and the good the self-less simple.

In that both are thus expressed according to their concept, their unity at the same time comes to light; for the in-self-existent being-for-self is the simple knowing; and the self-less simple is likewise the pure being-for-self that is in itself.

– Therefore, as much as it must be said that, according to this their concept, the good and evil — that is, in so far as they are not the good and the evil — are the same, so much must it also be said that they are not the same, but absolutely different; for the simple being-for-self, or also the pure knowing, are equally pure negativity, or the absolute difference in them themselves.

– Only these two propositions complete the whole, and to the asserting and assuring of the first must be opposed, with unconquerable stubbornness, the holding fast to the other; in that both are equally right, both are equally wrong, and their wrongness consists in taking such abstract forms as the same and not the same, identity and non-identity, for something true, firm, actual, and in resting on them.

Not the one or the other has truth, but precisely their movement, that the simple same is the abstraction and thereby the absolute difference, but this difference, as difference in itself, is distinguished from itself, and thus the self-sameness.

This is precisely the case with the sameness of the divine essence and of nature in general and of the human in particular; the former is nature, in so far as it is not essence; the latter is divine according to its essence; but it is spirit in which both abstract sides, as they are in truth, namely as sublated, are posited, – a positing that cannot be expressed through the judgment and the spiritless “is,” its copula.

– Likewise, nature is nothing outside its essence; but this nothing itself is just as much; it is the absolute abstraction, thus pure thinking or being-in-self, and with the moment of its opposition against the spiritual unity it is the evil.

The difficulty that takes place in these concepts is solely the holding fast to the “is” and the forgetting of the thinking, in which the moments just as much are as are not, – they are only the movement, which is spirit.

– This spiritual unity, or the unity in which the differences are only as moments or as sublated, is what has become for the representing consciousness in that reconciliation, and in that it is the universality of self-consciousness, this self-consciousness has ceased to be representing; the movement has gone back into it.
zh: 那自我意识的本质的被扬弃了的直接在场，就是它作为普遍的自我意识；因此，这个被扬弃了的个别自我——即绝对本质——的概念，就直接表达出教团的确立，教团先前一直停留在表象中，现在则返回到自身、返回到自我之中；于是，精神就从它的规定的第二个要素、即表象，过渡到第三个要素、即自我意识本身。
——如果我们再考察一下那个表象在它的进程中如何行事，我们首先就看到这一点被表达出来了：神性本质接纳人的本性。
在这一点中已经说出了：两者自在地并不是分离的；正如在神性本质从一开始就自己外化自己、它的定在返回自身并成为恶这件事中，这一点没有被说出来，却被包含在里面：这种恶的定在自在地并不是对它陌生的东西；如果事实上存在着对它而言的他者，如果存在着从它那里的堕落，绝对本质就只是一个空名；——自身内存在的环节毋宁说构成了精神的自我的那个本质环节。
——自身内存在、以及由此才有的现实性是属于本质本身的，这一点对我们来说是概念、并且只要它是概念，它在表象着的意识面前就表现为一件不可以概念把握的事件；自在对它就取得无差别的存在的形式。
但是，那个思想——即绝对本质的那些环节和自为存在的自我的那些仿佛相互逃避的环节并不是分离的——也出现在这个表象那里，因为它拥有真实的内容，但只是在以后，即在神性本质的外化中，那本质成为肉。
这个表象以这种方式还是直接的、因此还不是精神的，或者说它只知道本质的人的形态还只是一种特殊的、还不是普遍的形态；这个表象在那有形态的本质的运动中——即重新献出它的直接定在并返回本质——对这个意识来说就成为精神的；那在自身中反思过的本质才是精神。
——因此，神性本质同一般的他者、并确定地同它自己的思想、即恶的和解，就在这里面被表象出来了。
——如果这个和解按照它的概念被这样表达：它在于，恶自在地就是善所是的那个东西，或者说神性本质就是那整个范围内的自然所是的东西，正如那同神性本质分离的自然只是虚无，——那么，这就要被看作一种无精神的表达自己的方式，这种方式必然会引起误解。
——既然恶与善是同一个东西，那么恶恰恰不是恶，善也不是善，而是两者都被扬弃了：恶根本就是那在自身中存在的自为存在，而善就是那无自我的单纯的东西。
既然两者这样按照它们的概念被表达出来，它们的统一同时也就明朗起来了；因为那在自身中存在的自为存在就是单纯的知识；而那无自我的单纯的东西同样就是那纯粹的在自身中存在的自为存在。
——因此，正如必须说：按照它们的这个概念，善与恶——也就是说，只要它们不是善和恶——是同一个东西，同样也必须说：它们不是同一个东西，而是全然不同的；因为单纯的自为存在、或者说纯粹的知识，同样就是纯粹的否定性，或者说它们自己本身的绝对差别。
——只有这两个命题才完成整体；对于第一个命题的主张和保证，必须以不可克服的顽固坚持另一个命题与之相对；既然两者同样有理，两者就同样无理，而它们的无理就在于：把这样一些抽象的形式——如同一和非同一、同一性和非同一性——当作某种真的、固定的、现实的东西，并依据它们。
拥有真理的不是这一个或另一个，而恰恰是它们的运动：那单纯的同一就是抽象、从而是绝对差别，而这差别作为在自身的差别，又同它自身有差别，从而是自身等同。
神性本质与自然——一般的自然、特别是人的自然——的同一，也正是这种情形；前者是自然，只要它不是本质；后者按照它的本质是神性的；但两者那些抽象的方面——如其在真理中那样、即作为被扬弃的方面——是在精神中被设定的，——这是一种设定，它不能通过判断、也不能通过判断的那个无精神的连系词「是」来表达。
——同样，自然在它的本质之外就什么都不是；但这个虚无本身也同样存在着；它就是绝对的抽象，从而是纯粹的思维或自身内存在；而就它同精神的统一相对立这一环节来说，它就是恶。
在这些概念中存在的困难，只是坚持「是」、忘记了思维；在思维中，各个环节同样地既存在又不存在，——它们只是运动，只是精神。
——这种精神的统一、或者说差别只作为环节、只作为被扬弃的东西而在其中的那种统一，就是那个在那和解中为表象着的意识而生成了的东西；并且由于它就是自我意识的普遍性，自我意识就不再是表象着的了；运动已经返回到它里面。

en: Spirit is therefore posited in the third element, in universal self-consciousness; it is its community.
The movement of the community, as the self-consciousness that distinguishes itself from its representation, is to bring forth what has become in itself.
The dead divine human being, or human God, is in itself universal self-consciousness; it has to become this for this self-consciousness.

Or, since it constitutes one side of the opposition of representation, namely the evil side, for which natural determinate being and individual being-for-self count as the essence, this side, which is represented as self-subsistent but not yet as a moment, must, for the sake of its self-subsistence, raise itself to spirit in and for itself, or exhibit the movement of spirit in it.
zh: 因此，精神就在第三个要素中、在普遍的自我意识中被设定；它就是它的教团。
教团作为把自己同自己的表象区别开来的自我意识，其运动就是把那已经成为自在的东西产生出来。
死去了的神圣人，或者说人神，自在地就是普遍的自我意识；它必须为这个自我意识而成为这个。
或者说，既然它构成表象之对立的一面，即恶的一面——对于这一面，自然的定在和个别的自为存在被当作本质——那么这一面，它在表象中虽被当作独立的、却还没有被当作环节，就必须为了它的独立性本身而自在自为地把自己提升为精神，或者在它身上展示出精神的运动。

en: It is the natural spirit; the self has to withdraw from this naturalness and go into itself, which would mean becoming evil.
But it is already in itself evil; the going-into-itself therefore consists in convincing oneself that natural determinate being is evil.

In representational consciousness fall the existent becoming-evil and being-evil of the world, as well as the existent reconciliation of the absolute essence; but in self-consciousness as such falls, as regards form, this represented content only as a sublated moment — for the self is the negative — hence knowing, a knowing that is a pure activity of consciousness within itself.
— In the content, too, this moment of the negative must express itself.

Since, namely, the essence is in itself already reconciled with itself and is spiritual unity, in which the parts of the representation are sublated, or are moments, this shows itself in the fact that here each part of the representation receives the opposite meaning from the one it had before; each meaning thereby completes itself in the other, and the content is only thereby a spiritual one; since the determinacy is just as much its opposite, unity is in otherness, and the spiritual is complete; just as previously, for us or in itself, the opposite meanings united and themselves sublated even the abstract forms of the Same and the Not-same, of identity and non-identity.
zh: 它就是自然的精神；自我必须从这种自然性中退回来、进入自身，那便是变恶。
但它自在地已经就是恶；因此，进入自身就在于使自己确信：自然的定在就是恶。
世界中定在的变恶与为恶，以及绝对本质定在的和解，都归于表象的意识；而归于自我意识本身的，在形式上只是这个被表象者的被扬弃了的环节——因为自我就是否定者——因而也就是知识，一种意识在自身内的纯粹行动。
——在内容上，否定性的这个环节同样必须表达出来。

因为本质自在地已经与自己和解，并且就是精神的统一，在这种统一中，表象的各个部分都是被扬弃了的、亦即环节；所以这一点就表现为：表象的每一部分在这里都获得了与它此前相反的意义；每个意义都借此在另一个意义中使自己完备起来，内容也只有这样才是精神的；既然规定性同样就是它的对立面，统一性就在他在之中，精神性的东西就是完满的；正如先前对于我们或者自在地来说，那些相反的意义联合起来，并且连同者与非同者、同一性与非同一性这些抽象形式本身也被扬弃了。

en: If, therefore, in representational consciousness the becoming-inward of natural self-consciousness was the existent evil, then the becoming-inward in the element of self-consciousness is the knowing of evil as such, which is in itself in determinate being.
This knowing is indeed a becoming-evil, but only the becoming of the thought of evil, and is therefore recognized as the first moment of reconciliation.
For as a return into itself out of the immediacy of nature, which is determined as the evil, it is an abandoning of the same and the dying away of sin.
It is not natural determinate being as such that is abandoned by consciousness, but it at the same time as one that is known as evil.

The immediate movement of going-into-itself is just as much a mediated one — it presupposes itself, or is its own ground; the ground of going-into-itself is, namely, that nature has already in itself gone into itself; because of evil the human being must go into itself, but evil is itself the going-into-itself.
— This first movement is therefore itself only the immediate one, or its simple concept, because it is the same as its ground.
The movement, or the becoming-other, must therefore still occur in its more proper form.
zh: 因此，如果说在表象的意识中，自然自我意识的内在化就是定在的恶，那么，在自我意识的要素中，内在化就是对恶本身的知识，是知道恶自在地就在定在之中。
这种知识确实是一种变恶，但只是恶的思想的生成，因此它作为和解的第一个环节被承认。
因为作为从自然的直接性——这种直接性被规定为恶——返回自身，它就是对这种直接性的离弃，就是罪的死灭。
被意识离弃的并非自然的定在本身，而是它同时作为那种被知道为恶的东西。
进入自身的直接运动，同样也是一种被中介了的运动——它以自身为前提，或者说它就是自己的根据；进入自身的根据就在于：自然已经自在地进入自身了；人必须因为恶而进入自身，但恶本身就是进入自身。
——因此，这第一个运动本身就只是直接的，或者说只是它的简单的概念，因为它同它的根据就是同一个东西。
因此，运动或者说变成他在，还必须以它更确切的形式出现。

en: Besides this immediacy, therefore, the mediation of representation is necessary.
In itself, the knowing of nature as the untrue determinate being of spirit, and this universality of the self that has become inward, is the reconciliation of spirit with itself.
This in-itself acquires, for the self-consciousness that does not comprehend, the form of a being and of something represented to it.

Comprehending is therefore for it not a grasping of this concept, which knows the sublated naturalness as universal, hence as reconciled with itself, but a grasping of that representation, that through the happening of the divine essence's own externalization, through its accomplished becoming-human and its death, the divine essence is reconciled with its determinate being.

— The grasping of this representation now expresses more determinately what was previously called in it the spiritual resurrection, or the becoming of its individual self-consciousness into the universal or into the community.
— The death of the divine human being, as death, is abstract negativity, the immediate result of the movement, which only ends in natural universality.

It loses this natural meaning in spiritual self-consciousness, or becomes its just-indicated concept; death is transfigured from what it immediately means, from the non-being of this individual, into the universality of spirit, which lives in its community, dies in it daily and rises again.
zh: 因此，除了这种直接性之外，表象的中介是必要的。
自在地看来，把自然认作精神的不真的定在的那种知识，以及自我这已经进入自身的普遍性，就是精神与自身的和解。
这个自在，对于那不以概念把握的自我意识，就取得了一个存在者的、并且被它表象的东西的形式。
因此，以概念把握对于它就不是抓住这个概念——这个概念把被扬弃了的自然性当作普遍的、即当作与自己和解了的——而是抓住那个表象，即：通过神圣本质的自身外化的发生、通过它已经变成了人以及它的死，神圣本质就同它的定在和解了。
——抓住这个表象，这就更确切地表达了此前在其中被称作精神的复活的东西，亦即它的个别的自我意识向普遍的东西、向教团的生成。
——神人的死作为死，是抽象的否定性，是运动的直接结果，这运动仅仅在自然的普遍性中告终。
它在精神的自我意识中失去了这种自然的意义，或者说变成了它刚才所指明的概念；死就从它直接所意谓的东西、从这个个体的非存在，被转化为精神的普遍性，这普遍性在自己的教团中活着，每天都在其中死去并复活。

en: What belongs to the element of representation, namely that the absolute spirit represents the nature of spirit as an individual, or rather as a particular, in its determinate being, is therefore here transferred into self-consciousness itself, into the knowing that preserves itself in its otherness; this therefore does not really die, as the particular is represented to have really died, but its particularity dies away in its universality, that is, in its knowing, which is the essence reconciling itself with itself.

The immediately preceding element of representing is therefore here posited as sublated, or it has gone back into the self, into its concept; what in it was merely something that is has become subject.

At the same time, the first element too, pure thinking and the eternal spirit in it, is no longer beyond the representational consciousness, nor beyond the self; rather, the return of the whole into itself is precisely this: to contain all moments in itself.
The death of the mediator, grasped by the self, is the sublation of its objectivity or of its particular being-for-self; this particular being-for-self has become universal self-consciousness.
— On the other side, the universal has precisely thereby become self-consciousness, and the pure or unactual spirit of mere thinking has become actual.

— The death of the mediator is the death not only of the natural side of it or of its particular being-for-self; not only does the shell, already dead and detached from the essence, die, but also the abstraction of the divine essence.

For it is, in so far as its death has not yet completed the reconciliation, the one-sided element, which knows the simple of thinking as the essence in opposition to actuality; this extreme of the self does not yet have equal worth with the essence; the self has this only in spirit.
The death of this representation therefore at the same time contains the death of the abstraction of the divine essence, which is not posited as self.
It is the painful feeling of the unhappy consciousness that God himself has died.

This hard expression is the expression of the innermost simply knowing itself, the return of consciousness into the depth of the night of the I = I, which distinguishes and knows nothing outside itself any more.

This feeling is therefore in fact the loss of substance and of its confronting consciousness; but at the same time it is the pure subjectivity of substance, or the pure certainty of itself, which was lacking to it as object, or as the immediate, or as the pure essence.
This knowing, therefore, is the inspiration, whereby substance has become subject, its abstraction and lifelessness have died, and it has thus become actual, simple, and universal self-consciousness.
zh: 因此，属于表象之要素的东西——即绝对精神作为一个个体、或者毋宁说作为一个特殊者，在它的定在中把精神的本性表象出来——在这里就被移置到自我意识本身之中，移置到那在自己的他在中保持自身的知识里；因此，这并不像那个特殊者被表象为现实地死了那样现实地死，而是它的特殊性在它的普遍性中、即在它的知识中消逝，而这知识就是与自己和解着的本质。
因此，那直接先行于表象的要素在这里被设定为被扬弃了的，或者说它已经返回到自我之中、返回到它的概念之中；在那里面仅仅是存在者的东西，变成了主体。
与此同时，第一个要素——纯粹的思维以及在它之中的永恒的精神——也不再在表象的意识或自我的彼岸了；毋宁说，整体向自身的返回恰恰就在于：把一切环节都包含在自身之内。
被自我抓住了的中介者的死，就是对它的对象性、或者说对它的特殊的自为存在的扬弃；这个特殊的自为存在已经变成了普遍的自我意识。
——在另一方面，普遍的东西正因此就成了自我意识，而纯粹的、或者说还不现实的思想的精神，就变成了现实的。
——中介者的死，不只是它的自然一面、或者说它的特殊的自为存在的死；死掉的不仅是那个已经从本质脱落下来的、已经死去了的外壳，而且还有神圣本质的抽象。
因为，既然它的死还没有完成和解，它就是一个片面的东西，这个东西把思维的单纯者认作与现实性相对立的本质；自我的这个极端还没有同本质同等的价值；这一点，自我只有在精神中才获得。
因此，这个表象的死同时就包含着那种没有被设定为自我的神圣本质的抽象的死。
它就是苦恼意识的那种痛苦的感受：上帝本身已经死了。
这个严酷的说法，就是最内在的东西对自己单纯的知的说法，就是意识返回到 Ich = Ich 这夜晚的深处，而这深处除了自身之外，不再区别、不再知道任何东西。
因此，这种感受实际上就是实体及其与意识相对立的丧失；但它同时就是实体的纯粹主观性，或者说实体对自身的纯粹确定性，而这正是实体作为对象、作为直接的东西、作为纯粹的本质时所缺少的。
因此，这种知识就是精神化，实体由此变成了主体，它的抽象和无生命性由此死去，它因此变成了现实的、单纯的、普遍的自我意识。

en: Thus spirit is spirit that knows itself; it knows itself; what is an object for it is, or its representation is the true absolute content; as we saw, it expresses spirit itself.
At the same time it is not only the content of self-consciousness and not only an object for it, but is also actual spirit.

It is this by running through the three elements of its nature; this movement through itself constitutes its actuality; – what moves is it, it is the subject of the movement, and it is equally the moving itself, or the substance through which the subject passes.

As the concept of spirit had come to be for us when we entered religion, namely as the movement of the spirit certain of itself, which forgives evil and therein at the same time desists from its own simplicity and hard unchangeability, or as the movement in which the absolutely opposed recognizes itself as the same and this knowing breaks forth as the yes between these extremes — this concept the religious consciousness, for which the absolute essence is manifest, beholds, and it sublates the distinction between its own self and what it beholds; it is, as it is the subject, so also the substance, and is thus itself spirit, precisely because and insofar as it is this movement.
zh: 所以，精神就是自己知道自己的精神；它知道自己；对它为对象的东西是存在的，或者说它的表象是真正的绝对内容；如我们所见，它把精神本身表达出来。
同时，它不只是自我意识的内容，也不只是对自我意识而言的对象，而且也是现实的精神。
它就是这一点，因为它经历着自己本性的三个元素；这种穿越自身的运动构成它的现实性；——运动者就是它，它是运动的主体，而它同样也是运动本身，或者说，是主体得以穿行而过的那种实体。

正如我们进入宗教时精神的概念对我们成了的那样，亦即那个对自己有确定性的精神的运动——它宽恕恶，并由此同时放弃自己那种单纯和僵硬的不变性——，或者说那个运动：绝对对立的东西在其中认识到自己是同一的，而这个认识作为一声“是”迸发在这两个极端之间，——宗教意识（对它来说绝对本质是显明的）直观着这个概念，并扬弃它的自我与它所直观者之间的区别；它像它是主体那样，也是实体，因而本身就是精神，这正是因为并且只要它是这一运动。

en: But this community is not yet perfected in this its self-consciousness; its content is in general for it in the form of representing, and this diremption also still attaches to its actual spirituality, its return out of its representing, just as the element of pure thinking itself was still affected by it.

It does not also have consciousness of what it is; it is the spiritual self-consciousness that is not itself this object, or that does not open itself up into the consciousness of itself; but insofar as it is consciousness, it has representations, which have been considered.
– We see self-consciousness become inward at its last turning point and arrive at the knowledge of being-within-self; we see it externalize its natural determinate being and gain pure negativity.

But the positive meaning, namely that this negativity or pure inwardness of knowing is equally the self-identical essence — or that the substance therein comes to be absolute self-consciousness — this is an other for the devout consciousness.

It grasps this side, that the pure becoming-inward of knowing is in itself absolute simplicity or substance, as the representation of something that is not so in accordance with the concept, but as the action of an alien satisfaction.

Or it is not this for it, that this depth of the pure self is the power whereby the abstract essence is dragged down out of its abstraction and, through the might of this pure devotion, raised up into a self.

– The doing of the self thereby retains this negative meaning over against it, because the externalization of the substance is, on its side, an in-itself for that consciousness, which it does not equally grasp and comprehend, or does not find in its doing as such.
– Since this unity of essence and self has come about in itself, consciousness also still has this representation of its reconciliation, but as a representation.

It attains satisfaction by externally adding to its pure negativity the positive meaning of its unity with the essence; its satisfaction therefore itself remains encumbered with the opposition of a beyond.

Its own reconciliation therefore enters into its consciousness as something distant, as a distance of the future, just as the reconciliation accomplished by the other self appears as a distance of the past.

Just as the individual divine human has an in-itself father and only an actual mother, so the universal divine human, the community, too has its own doing and knowing as its father, but as its mother the eternal love, which it only feels but does not behold in its consciousness as an actual immediate object.
Its reconciliation is therefore in its heart, but still divided from its consciousness, and its actuality is still broken.

What enters into its consciousness as the in-itself, or the side of pure mediation, is the reconciliation that lies in the beyond; but what is present, as the side of immediacy and determinate being, is the world, which still has its transfiguration to await.
It is indeed in itself reconciled with the essence; and of the essence it is indeed known that it no longer recognizes the object as itself estranged, but in its love as equal to itself.
But for self-consciousness this immediate presence does not yet have the shape of spirit.

The spirit of the community is thus, in its immediate consciousness, separated from its religious consciousness, which indeed declares that they are not separated in themselves, but declares an in-itself that is not actualized, or has not yet equally become absolute being-for-itself.
zh: 但是这个教团在它的这种自我意识中还没有完成；它的内容总的说来还以表象的形式为它而存在，而这种分裂也仍然附着于它的现实的精神性，即它从它的表象中的返回，正如纯粹思维的元素本身也曾带有这种分裂一样。
它也并不具有关于它是什么的意识；它是那种精神的自我意识，本身还不是这样的对象，也没有敞开为对自身的意识；但就它是意识而言，它具有一些曾经被考察过的表象。
——我们看到，自我意识在它最后的转折点上成为内在的，达到对自身内存在的知识；我们看到它外化自己自然的定在，赢得纯粹的否定性。
但是那肯定的意义，即这种否定性或认识的纯粹内在性同样就是自身同一的本质——或者说，实体在此达到了绝对自我意识——这一点，对虔诚意识来说是另一个东西。
它把握这一面，即认识的纯粹内在化本身就是绝对的单纯或实体，但它是把这一点当作某种东西的表象来把握的，而那样东西并不是在概念上如此；而是当作一个异己的满足的行动来把握的。
或者说，对它来说并不是这样：纯粹自我的这种深度就是那种强力，抽象的实体被它从抽象中拖拽下来，并凭着这种纯粹虔诚的力量被提升为自我。
——自我的行动因此对它保持着这种否定的意义，因为实体的外化从它那一方面说对那个虔诚意识是一个自在，是这个意识并没有同样地把握并以概念把握的东西，或者说，是它没有在自己的行动本身中发现的东西。
——既然本质与自我的这种统一已经自在地达成了，意识也就还拥有它的和解的表象，但只是作为表象。
它靠从外面把它的统一于本质的肯定意义加给它的纯粹否定性来获得满足；所以它的满足本身也仍然带着一个彼岸的对立。
因此，它自己的和解作为一个遥远的东西进入它的意识，作为未来的遥远，正如另一个自我所完成的和解显现为过去的遥远一样。
正如个别的神圣的人有一个自在存在着的父亲、只有一个现实的母亲那样，普遍的神圣的人即教团，也把它自己的行动和知识当作父亲，而把永恒的爱当作母亲，这爱它只是感觉到，并没有在它的意识中作为现实的直接的对象来直观。
因此，它的和解就在它的心中，但与它的意识还是分裂的，并且它的现实性还是破碎的。
作为自在、作为纯粹中介的那一面进入它的意识的，是位于彼岸的和解；而作为当下的、作为直接性和定在的那一侧的，是世界，世界还要等待它的变容。
它确实是自在地与本质和解了；并且，本质也确实被认识到：它不再把对象认识为与自身相异化的东西，而是在它的爱中把对象认识为与它自己相同一。
但是对自我意识来说，这种直接在场还没有精神的形态。
因此，教团的精神在它的直接意识中与它的宗教意识相分离，后者固然说出它们自在地并没有分离，但说出的只是一个还没有实现的、或者说还没有同样成为绝对自为存在的自在。
